cards.name: Rainbow Energy
rules: Attach Rainbow Energy to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, Rainbow Energy counts as every type of basic Energy but only provides 1 Energy at a time. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card when not in play.) When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, it does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.)

cards.name: Dark Alakazam

attacks.name: Teleport Blast
attacks.text: You may switch Dark Alakazam with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Mind Shock
attacks.text: Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

cards.flavorText: Almost as if it were being controlled by something else, it never changes expressions, even in the middle of battle.

cards.name: Dark Arbok

attacks.name: Stare
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.) If that Pokémon has a Pokémon Power, that power stops working until the end of your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Poison Vapor
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Freezes its prey with its stare. If you should encounter one, remember not to look into its eyes.

cards.name: Dark Blastoise

attacks.name: Hydrocannon
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Dark Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack. You can't add more than 40 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Rocket Tackle
attacks.text: Dark Blastoise does 10 damage to itself. Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Dark Blastoise during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

cards.flavorText: An aggressive Pokémon that tackles anything it sees.

cards.name: Dark Charizard

attacks.name: Continuous Fireball
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Fire Energy cards attached to Dark Charizard. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads. Discard a number of Fire Energy cards attached to Dark Charizard equal to the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Seemingly possessed, it spews fire like a volcano, trying to burn all it sees.

cards.flavorText: Sometimes called "The God of Destruction." Its wings are able to support it in spite of its massive weight.

cards.name: Dark Dugtrio

abilities.name: Sinkhole
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon retreats, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, this power does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power stops working while Dark Dugtrio is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Knock Down
attacks.text: Your opponent flips a coin. If tails, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if heads, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.flavorText: Digs large sinkholes in the ground and tries to trap its enemies in them.

cards.name: Dark Golbat

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.text: When you play Dark Golbat from your hand, you may choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you do, Dark Golbat does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Sneaks up silently on its prey and attacks it from behind, sometimes killing it with one bite.

cards.name: Dark Gyarados

abilities.name: Final Beam
abilities.text: When Dark Gyarados is Knocked Out by an attack, flip a coin. This power doesn't work if Dark Gyarados is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Normally found only in the deep ocean, it has recently been seen in shallow waters as well.

cards.name: Dark Hypno

attacks.name: Bench Manipulation
attacks.text: Your opponent flips a number of coins equal to the number of Pokémon on his or her Bench. This attack does 20 damage times the number of tails. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

cards.flavorText: Carries a pendulum with it always. Sometimes appears near less-traveled roads and schools at dusk.

cards.name: Dark Machamp

attacks.name: Fling
attacks.text: Your opponent shuffles his or her Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it into his or her deck. This attack can't be used if your opponent has no Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is almost impossible to defend against a Machamp's four powerful arms.

cards.name: Dark Magneton

attacks.name: Sonicboom
attacks.text: Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

attacks.name: Magnetic Lines

cards.flavorText: The number of incidents of hackers using Magnetons to damage computer systems is steadily increasing.

cards.name: Dark Slowbro

attacks.name: Fickle Attack

cards.flavorText: It loves nothing better than to be left alone, and so sometimes ends up being manipulated by unscrupulous people.

cards.name: Dark Charmeleon

attacks.name: Fireball
attacks.text: Use this attack only if there are any Fire Energy cards attached to Dark Charmeleon. Flip a coin. If heads, discard 1 of those Energy cards. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

cards.flavorText: Its tail is incredibly strong, able to lift up to 5 adult men.

cards.name: Dark Dragonair

abilities.name: Evolutionary Light
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for an Evolution card. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Dark Dragonair is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Tail Strike
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.flavorText: As is fitting for a legendary Pokémon, it has many strange powers, including the ability to make rain or snow fall.

cards.name: Dark Electrode

attacks.name: Energy Bomb
attacks.text: Take all Energy cards attached to Dark Electrode and attach them to your Benched Pokémon (in any way you choose). If you have no Benched Pokémon, discard all Energy cards attached to Dark Electrode.

cards.flavorText: Some researchers hypothesize that Electrode may actually be a form of energy instead of having an actual body.

cards.name: Dark Flareon

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Dark Flareon.

attacks.name: Playing with Fire
attacks.text: Use this attack only if there are any Fire Energy cards attached to Dark Flareon. Flip a coin. If heads, discard 1 of those Energy cards and this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with a hot temper that can't be controlled once it's angered. Capable of breathing flames hotter than 3000°.

cards.name: Dark Gloom

abilities.name: Pollen Stench
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused; if tails, your Active Pokémon is now Confused. This power can't be used if Dark Gloom is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Its pollen has such a strong smell that it even confuses itself at times.

cards.name: Dark Golduck

attacks.name: Third Eye
attacks.text: Discard 1 Energy card attached to Dark Golduck in order to draw up to 3 cards.

cards.flavorText: When Psyducks evolve, their headaches disappear and they find themselves in possession of formidable mental powers.

cards.name: Dark Jolteon

attacks.name: Lightning Flash
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Thunder Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, Dark Jolteon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: A dangerous Pokémon when angered. It likes to playfully shock people with the electricity it stores within its body.

cards.name: Dark Kadabra

abilities.name: Matter Exchange
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a card from your hand in order to draw a card. This power can't be used if Dark Kadabra is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Mind Shock
attacks.text: Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

cards.flavorText: Some people say that Kadabras are responsible for many of the mysterious events reported in the news.

cards.name: Dark Machoke

attacks.name: Drag Off
attacks.text: Before doing damage, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. Do the damage to the new Defending Pokémon. This attack can't be used if your opponent has no Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Knock Back
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: While normally peaceful and friendly, the number of incidents involving cruel Machokes is rising.

cards.name: Dark Muk

abilities.name: Sticky Goo
abilities.text: As long as Dark Muk is your Active Pokémon, your opponent pays ColorlessColorless more to retreat his or her Active Pokémon. This power stops working while Dark Muk is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Sludge Punch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Muks appear suddenly, spreading sludge everywhere. Whenever one appears in a city, panic ensues.

cards.name: Dark Persian

attacks.name: Fascinate
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. This attack can't be used if your opponent has no Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poison Claws
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Popular with women because of its beautiful fur. The leader of the Rockets keeps one as a pet.

cards.name: Dark Primeape

abilities.name: Frenzy

attacks.name: Frenzied Attack
attacks.text: Dark Primeape is now Confused (after doing damage).

cards.name: Dark Rapidash

attacks.name: Flame Pillar

cards.flavorText: A wild, uncontrollable Pokémon. When running, it looks like a comet streaking through the sky.

cards.name: Dark Vaporeon

attacks.name: Whirlpool

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon capable of controlling water, so it is capable of creating giant whirlpools.

cards.name: Dark Wartortle

attacks.name: Doubleslap

attacks.name: Psybeam

cards.flavorText: More and more people play the slots every day, trying to win a Porygon.

attacks.name: Vanish

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

cards.flavorText: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

cards.flavorText: Stores up electricity in its body, then suddenly releases it to surprise and shock everyone.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon capable of controlling water, so it is capable of creating giant whirlpools.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Flareon or this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.

cards.name: Gengar

abilities.name: Curse

attacks.name: Dark Mind
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Under a full moon, this Pokémon like to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

cards.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Bubblebeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

cards.name: Hitmonlee

attacks.name: Stretch Kick
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon, and this attack does 20 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

cards.name: Jolteon

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Pin Missle
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It accumulates negative ions from the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

cards.name: Machamp

abilities.name: Strikes Back
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent's attack damages Machamp (even if Machamp is Knocked Out), this power does 10 damage to the attacking Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power can't be used if Machamp is already affected by a Special Condition when your opponent attacks.

cards.flavorText: Using its amazing muscles, it throws powerful punches that can knock its victim clear over the horizon.

cards.name: Muk

abilities.name: Toxic Gas
abilities.text: Ignore all Pokémon Powers other than Toxic Gases. This power stops working while Muk is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Sludge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

cards.name: Ninetales

attacks.name: Lure
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Ninetales or this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

cards.name: Venusaur

abilities.name: Energy Trans
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may take 1 Grass Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon and attach it to a different one. This power can't be used if Venusaur is affected by a Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

cards.name: Zapdos

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Zapdos does 30 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy cards attached to Zapdos or this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

cards.name: Beedrill

attacks.name: Twineedle
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

cards.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Remove a number of damage counters from Butterfree equal of half the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Butterfree has fewer damage counters that that, remove all of them.

cards.flavorText: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

cards.name: Electrode

attacks.name: Chain Lightning
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon isn't Colorless, this attack does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon of the same type as the Defending Pokémon (including your own). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

cards.name: Exeggutor

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.text: Switch Exeggutor with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Big Eggsplosion
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy attached to Exeggutor. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

cards.name: Golem

attacks.name: Selfdestruct
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to each Pokémon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Golem does 100 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

cards.name: Hypno

attacks.name: Prophecy
attacks.text: Look at up to 3 cards from the top of either player's deck and rearrange them as you like.

attacks.name: Dark Mind
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

cards.name: Jynx

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Meditate
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

cards.name: Kabutops

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Remove a number of damage counters from Kabutops equal to half the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Kabutops has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

cards.flavorText: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

cards.name: Magneton

attacks.name: Sonicboom
attacks.text: Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

attacks.name: Selfdestruct
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to each Pokémon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Magneton does 100 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

cards.name: Mewtwo

attacks.name: Energy Control
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a basic Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and attach it to another of your opponent's Pokémon of your choice.

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

cards.flavorText: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

cards.name: Moltres

attacks.name: Wildfire
attacks.text: You may discard any number of Fire Energy cards attached to Moltres when you use this attack. If you do, discard that many cards from the top of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Dive Bomb
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

cards.name: Nidoking

attacks.name: Thrash

cards.flavorText: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

cards.name: Rhydon

cards.name: Arcanine

cards.name: Snivy

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.flavorText: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

cards.name: Swadloon

cards.flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

cards.name: Crustle

cards.flavorText: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.

cards.name: Virizion

attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Leaf Wallop
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Leaf Wallop does 40 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

cards.name: Genesect

attacks.name: Gaia Blaster

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

cards.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Draw In
attacks.text: Attach 2 Fire Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

cards.name: Charmeleon

attacks.name: Raging Claws
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

cards.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Firebreathing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

cards.name: Ninetales

attacks.name: Color Coordination

cards.flavorText: Each of its nine tails is imbued with supernatural power, and it can live for a thousand years.

cards.name: Moltres

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

cards.name: Victini

abilities.name: Victory Star
abilities.text: Once during your turn, after you flip any coins for an attack, you may ignore all effects of those coin flips and being flipping those coins again. You can't use more than 1 Victory Star Ability each turn.

attacks.text: Move all Energy attached to this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Victini-EX

cards.name: Tepig

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

cards.name: Pignite

attacks.name: Flamethrower

cards.flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When it trouble, it emits smoke.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

cards.name: Gyarados

cards.flavorText: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

cards.name: Articuno

attacks.name: Ice Beam

cards.name: Piplup

attacks.name: Water Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.name: Prinplup

attacks.name: Water Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

cards.name: Empoleon

attacks.name: Emperor's Strike
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has fewer remaining HP than the Defending Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.name: Phione

cards.name: Oshawott

attacks.name: Razor Shell
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 10 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Glinting Claw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Wild Kick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

cards.name: Sawsbuck

attacks.name: Take Down

cards.flavorText: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Sacred Sword during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

cards.name: Pansear

attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Splatter
attacks.text: Does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.

cards.name: Ducklett

attacks.name: Roost
attacks.text: Heal 40 damage from this Pokémon. This Pokémon can't retreat during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

cards.flavorText: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

cards.name: Galvantula

attacks.name: Cross Chop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailing finds all food buried deep underground.

cards.name: Weezing

attacks.name: Super Poison Breath
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Super Explosion
attacks.text: Weezing does 90 damage to itself, and don't apply Weakness to this damage.

cards.flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Zangoose

attacks.name: Swords Dance
attacks.text: During your next turn, Zangoose's Lost Claw attack's base damage is 80.

attacks.name: Lost Claw
attacks.text: Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and put it in the Lost Zone.

cards.flavorText: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.

cards.name: Bayleef
cards.flavorText: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

cards.name: Croconaw

attacks.name: Big Bite
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

cards.name: Donphan

attacks.name: Rock Hurl
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Double Spin
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

cards.name: Flaaffy

attacks.name: Thunder Spear
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

cards.name: Flareon

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to Flareon.

cards.flavorText: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Jolteon

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Jolteon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

cards.name: Magby

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Magby is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Magby by attacks.

attacks.name: Play with Fire
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned. Magby is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.

cards.name: Mime Jr.

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Mime Jr. is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Mime Jr. by attacks.

attacks.name: Sleepy Lost
attacks.text: Put the top card of your opponent's deck in the Lost Zone. Mime Jr. is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

cards.name: Pidgeotto

attacks.name: Twister
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this attack does nothing. For each heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It renders its prey immobile using well-developed claws, then carries the prey more than 60 miles to its nest.

cards.name: Quilava

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to Quilava.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

cards.name: Riolu

attacks.name: Tumble Over
attacks.text: Riolu can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

cards.name: Seviper

attacks.name: Poison Buildup
attacks.text: Seviper is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Poison Effect
attacks.text: If Seviper is Poisoned, this attack does 20 damage plus 60 more damage and remove the Special Condition Poisoned from Seviper.

cards.flavorText: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

cards.name: Vaporeon

attacks.name: Spiral Drain
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from Vaporeon.

attacks.name: Dual Splash
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

cards.name: Chikorita

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from Chikorita.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: Chikorita does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sunrays.

cards.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Minimize
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn ,any damage done to Clefairy by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

cards.name: Cyndaquil

attacks.name: Fireworks
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to Cyndaquil.

cards.flavorText: It is timid, and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Team Magma's Numel

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: No matter how heavy the cargo, we can transport it to our destination with ease, thanks to Numel.

cards.name: Team Magma's Camerupt

abilities.name: Burning Draft
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Fighting or Fire Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flame Ball
attacks.text: Move a basic Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Camerupt, with its strength against fire, played a big role in rescuing team members.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Spheal
cards.flavorText: Spheal's Water Gun can put out any fire. Flames used by opponents have no effect!

cards.name: Team Aqua's Sealeo

attacks.name: Splatter
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Hail Storm
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Team Magma Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It provides support by making paths of ice. It can win any battle as long as it's on ice.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Walrein

attacks.name: Power Blow
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage times the amount of Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dual Blizzard
attacks.text: Discard 2 Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It's good at attacks that freeze opponents with a powerful cold snap. Then, it pulverizes a frozen foe with its sharp tusks!

cards.name: Team Aqua's Kyogre-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Power Saver
abilities.text: If there are 4 or fewer Team Aqua Pokémon in play, this Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Aqua Impact
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Grimer
cards.flavorText: Its flexible body, which allows it to squeeze into any cracks, comes in handy when invading enemy hideouts.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Muk

abilities.name: Sludge Festival
abilities.text: The Retreat Cost of each Pokémon in play (except for Team Aqua Pokémon) is Colorless more.

attacks.name: Pester
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It immobilizes its opponents by wrapping them in its huge, poisonous body. It'll smoosh you, too!

cards.name: Team Aqua's Seviper

attacks.name: Venomous Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Venom Tail
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, discard an Energy attached to that Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Seviper's tail is a sharp blade. It can even poison you!

cards.name: Team Magma's Baltoy

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

cards.flavorText: They all cry out at once to let us know when they spot an enemy. It really helps out!

cards.name: Team Magma's Claydol

abilities.name: Magma Switch
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move a basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to 1 of your Team Magma Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Claydol's beam can seize opponents and keep them from moving. Long-range attacks are its specialty!

cards.name: Team Magma's Aron
cards.flavorText: Aron, which even devour metal, can eat and destroy enemy ships in an instant.

cards.name: Team Magma's Lairon

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: When Lairon uses Take Down, the impact from its solid body is enough to destroy concrete!

cards.name: Team Magma's Aggron

attacks.name: Rock Stomp
attacks.text: Discard as many Fighting Energy attached to your Pokémon as you like. This attack does 40 damage times the amount of Fighting Energy you discarded.

attacks.name: Boulder Storm
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Aggron's metal horns can smash through any defenses, no matter how strong!

cards.name: Team Magma's Groudon-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Power Saver
abilities.text: If there are 4 or fewer Team Magma Pokémon in play, this Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Magma Quake
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Poochyena

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Poochyena can easily detect invading foes with its acute sense of smell. It's an excellent lookout!

cards.name: Team Magma's Poochyena

attacks.name: Infiltrate
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals his or her hand.

cards.flavorText: Poochyena's nose can identify any scent. It's very useful for reconnaissance.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Mightyena

attacks.name: Teampact
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Team Aqua Pokémon you have in play. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Thanks to Mightyena's outstanding leadership, it's very good at combination attacks that can leave a foe helpless.

cards.name: Team Magma's Mightyena

attacks.name: Hostile Fang
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Team Aqua Pokémon, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is loyal to its master. It will protect its partner to the end, no matter what.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Carvanha

attacks.name: Fin Smack
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: You can't keep up with its movements underwater, can you? If you get caught in this whirlpool, there'll be no escape.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Sharpedo

abilities.name: Aqua Search
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Team Aqua Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It boasts fangs so powerful that they knock opponents out in one shot! Enemies that slip up will be taken down without fail!

cards.name: Team Magma's Zangoose

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Team Magma Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Team Play
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the number of Team Magma Pokémon on your Bench.

cards.flavorText: Can you handle the formation attack of the fearless Zangoose?

cards.name: Aqua Diffuser
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
The Team Aqua Pokémon this card is attached to can also use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.)
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

attacks.name: Aqua Diffuser
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

cards.name: Magma Pointer
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
The Team Magma Pokémon this card is attached to can also use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.)
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

attacks.name: Magma Pointer
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Team Aqua Admin
rules: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to your Active Team Aqua Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Team Aqua Grunt
rules: Discard a card from your hand. (If you can't discard a card, you can't play this card.) Draw 3 cards. If you discarded a Team Aqua Pokémon, draw 1 more card.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Team Aqua's Great Ball
rules: Search your deck for a Basic Team Aqua Pokémon and a basic Water Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Team Aqua's Secret Base
rules: The Retreat Cost of each Pokémon in play (except for Team Aqua Pokémon) is Colorless more.
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

cards.name: Team Magma Admin
rules: Put up to 3 Team Magma Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Team Magma Grunt
rules: Discard a card from your hand. (If you can't discard a card, you can't play this card.) Draw 3 cards. If you discarded a Team Magma Pokémon, draw 1 more card.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Team Magma's Great Ball
rules: Search your deck for a Basic Team Magma Pokémon and a basic Fighting Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Team Magma's Secret Base
rules: Whenever any player puts a Basic Pokémon (except for Team Magma Pokémon) from his or her hand onto his or her Bench, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

cards.name: Double Aqua Energy
rules: This card can only be attached to Team Aqua Pokémon. Discard this card at the end of the turn you attached it.
This card provides WaterWater Energy only while it is attached to a Team Aqua Pokémon.
(If this card is attached to anything other than a Team Aqua Pokémon, discard this card.)

cards.name: Double Magma Energy
rules: This card can only be attached to Team Magma Pokémon. Discard this card at the end of the turn you attached it.
This card provides FightingFighting Energy only while it is attached to a Team Magma Pokémon.
(If this card is attached to anything other than a Team Magma Pokémon, discard this card.)

cards.name: Bulbasaur

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

cards.name: Ludicolo

abilities.name: Table Service
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Punch and Run
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

cards.name: Morelull

attacks.name: Sleep Spore
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they're dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.

cards.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charizard

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 50 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

cards.name: Arcanine

abilities.name: Security Guard
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, all of your Pokémon take 30 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.

cards.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Panic
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Hold Still
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

cards.name: Greninja

abilities.name: Evasion Jutsu
abilities.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

attacks.name: Furious Shurikens
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

cards.name: Detective Pikachu

attacks.name: Scout
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: He loves to show off his vast knowledge. This expressive Pikachu is like a middle-aged man.

cards.name: Mr. Mime

abilities.name: Pantomime
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may switch 1 of your face-down Prize cards with the top card of your deck.

attacks.name: Juggling
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

cards.name: Mewtwo

attacks.name: Psyjack
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Break Burn
attacks.text: Discard 2 Psychic Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was created by years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

cards.name: Machamp

attacks.name: Directing Traffic
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.

attacks.name: Cross Chop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It grasps its opponents with its four arms and twists them up in an intricate hold. People call it "the Machamp special."

cards.name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Healing Melody
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

cards.name: Snubbull

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

cards.name: Lickitung

attacks.name: Continuous Lick
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

cards.name: Ditto

attacks.name: Copy Anything
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack. If this Pokémon doesn't have the necessary Energy to use that attack, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: While it can transform into anything, each Ditto apparently has its own strengths and weaknesses when it comes to transformations.

cards.name: Slaking

attacks.name: Pitch
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

cards.name: Dialga

attacks.name: Time Bellow
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Flash Cannon
attacks.text: You may return all Energy cards attached to Dialga to your hand. If you do, remove the highest Stage Evolution card from the Defending Pokémon and shuffle that card into your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Dusknoir

abilities.name: Dark Palm
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if your opponent has 4 or more Benched Pokémon, you may choose 1 of them and shuffle that Pokémon and all cards attached to it into his or her deck. This power can't be used if Dusknoir if affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hard Feelings
attacks.text: Put 5 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. Then, count the number of Prize cards your opponent has taken and put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

cards.name: Electivire

abilities.name: Intense Voltage
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), if Elekid is anywhere under Electivire, you may move a Lightning Energy attached to your Pokémon to Electivire. This power can't be used if Electivire is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: You may discard all Lightning Energy attached to Electivire. If you do, this attack's base damage is 120 instead of 60.

cards.flavorText: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

cards.name: Empoleon

attacks.name: Ice Blade
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Aqua Jet
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

cards.name: Infernape

attacks.name: Meteor Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Flare Blitz
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy attached to Infernape.

cards.flavorText: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

cards.name: Lucario

attacks.name: Feint
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Aura Sphere
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

cards.name: Luxray

abilities.name: Gleam Eyes
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Luxray from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may look at your opponent's hand. If your opponent's Bench isn't full, choose 1 Basic Pokémon from your opponent's hand, and put it onto his or her Bench. Then, switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Lightning Star
attacks.text: Move all Lightning Energy attached to Luxray to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Ignore this effect if you don't have any Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

cards.name: Magnezone

abilities.name: Magnetize
abilities.text: If you have any Metal Energy attached to your Active Pokémon, the Retreat Cost for that Pokémon is 0.

attacks.name: Metal Blast
attacks.text: Does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each Metal Energy attached to Magnezone.

cards.flavorText: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

cards.name: Manaphy

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Aqua Ring
attacks.text: Switch Manaphy with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

cards.name: Mismagius

attacks.name: Avenge
attacks.text: Count the number of your Pokémon that have any damage counters on them. Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psywave
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

cards.name: Palkia

attacks.name: Spacial Rend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Stadium card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If there is any Stadium card in play, discard it.

attacks.name: Transback
attacks.text: You may flip a coin. If heads, discard all Energy attached to Palkia and put the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it on top of your opponent's deck. Your opponent shuffles his or her deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

cards.name: Rhyperior

abilities.name: Earth Fissure
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Rhyperior from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may discard the top 3 cards from your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Rock Wrecker
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. Rhyperior can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

cards.name: Roserade

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Spike Whip
attacks.text: If Budew is anywhere under Roserade, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

cards.name: Shiftry

abilities.name: Darkness Fan
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Shiftry is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Evolved Pokémon on your opponent's Bench, remove the highest Stage Evolution card from that Pokémon, and put it back into his or her hand. This power can't be used if Shiftry is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Spirit Dance
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

cards.name: Skuntank

attacks.name: Frustration
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that doesn't have any damage counters on it. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Toxic Cloud
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on the Defending Pokémon between turns.

cards.flavorText: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

cards.name: Staraptor

attacks.name: Accelerative Dive
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all damage done to Staraptor by attacks (both yours and your opponent's) until the end of your next turn.

attacks.name: Brave Heart
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Staraptor does 100 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

cards.name: Torterra

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Leaf Storm
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from each of your Grass Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

cards.name: Azumarill

attacks.name: Defense Curl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Azumarill during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Bubble Pump
attacks.text: If Azumarill has 3 or more Energy attached to it, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage. If Azurill is anywhere under Azumarill, flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.

cards.name: Beautifly

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: After your attack, remove from Beautifly the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

cards.name: Bibarel

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.text: Remove all Special Conditions and 4 damage counters from Bibarel. Bibarel is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Bibarel does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

cards.name: Carnivine

attacks.name: Swallow Up
attacks.text: Before doing damage, count the remaining HP of the Defending Pokémon and Carnivine. If the Defending Pokémon has fewer remaining HP than Carnivine's, this attack does 60 damage instead.

attacks.name: Wring Out
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

cards.name: Clefable

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Metronome
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. Metronome copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else in order to use that attack.) Clefable performs that attack.

cards.flavorText: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.

cards.name: Drapion

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Poison Claws
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

cards.name: Drifblim

attacks.name: Wind Wave
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 5 in any combination of Pokémon and Supporter cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

attacks.name: Explosive Smoke
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It's drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

cards.name: Dustox

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Toxic Dust
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on the Defending Pokémon between turns.

cards.flavorText: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

cards.name: Floatzel

attacks.name: Screw Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Floatzel but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 40 damage in this way.

cards.flavorText: It floats using its well-developed floatation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

cards.name: Gengar

attacks.name: Life Drain
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put damage counter on the Defending Pokémon until it is 10 HP away from being Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Shadow Dance
attacks.text: Put 4 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like. Then, switch Gengar with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools that area by nearly 10 degrees F.

cards.name: Heracross

attacks.name: Pitch
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Horn Slash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It's strong enough to hurl foes.

cards.name: Hippowdon

attacks.name: Vacuum Up
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Sand Eject
attacks.text: During your next turn, if an attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

cards.name: Lopunny

attacks.name: Healing Wish
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. Remove a number of damage counters equal to the number of heads from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flop
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) You may switch Lopunny with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

cards.name: Machamp

attacks.name: Revenge
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during his or her last turn, this attack does 20 damage plus 50 more damage.

attacks.name: Dynamic Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 damage plus 30 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.

cards.name: Medicham

attacks.name: Force Palm
attacks.text: Count the number of damage counters on Medicham. Put that many damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spinning Kick
attacks.text: Medicham does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Through yoga training, it has honed its sixth sense. Its movements are elegant.

cards.name: Munchlax

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Snorlax from your hand onto Munchlax (this counts as evolving Munchlax) and remove all damage counters from Munchlax.

attacks.name: Heave
attacks.text: Discard 2 cards from your hand. (If you can't discard 2 cards, this attack does nothing.) Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

cards.name: Noctowl

attacks.name: See Beyond
attacks.text: Choose a card from your hand and put it as a Prize card face up. Then, choose 1 of your face-down Prize cards without looking and put it into your hand. This attack does nothing if all of your Prize cards are face up.

attacks.name: Extrasensory
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 30 damage plus 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its eyes are special. They can pick out objects as long as there is the tiniest amount of light.

cards.name: Pachirisu

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running
attacks.text: Search your deck for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Pachirisu does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

cards.name: Purugly

attacks.name: High Hat
attacks.text: Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own.

cards.name: Snorlax

attacks.name: Block
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Ease Up
attacks.text: Snorlax is now Asleep. If Snorlax is evolved from Munchlax, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.

cards.name: Steelix

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Metal Slash
attacks.text: Steelix can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

cards.name: Vespiquen

attacks.name: Leaf Honey
attacks.text: Discard a Grass Energy attached to Vespiquen and remove all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Grass Pokémon.

attacks.name: Attack Order
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of Grass Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's).

cards.flavorText: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.

cards.name: Weavile

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.text: Search your deck for any 1 card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Dark Pulse
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the total amount of Darkness Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

cards.name: Wobbuffet

attacks.name: Countercharge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, move all damage counters from Wobbuffet to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

cards.name: Wynaut

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Wobbuffet from your hand onto Wynaut (this counts as evolving Wynaut) and remove all damage counters from Wynaut.

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking. Look at the card you chose, then have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck.

cards.flavorText: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.

cards.name: Budew

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Roselia from your hand onto Budew (this counts as evolving Budew) and remove all damage counters from Budew.

attacks.name: Errand-Running
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

cards.name: Cascoon

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if Cascoon would be damaged by an attack, prevent that attack's damage done to Cascoon if that damage is 30 or less.

attacks.name: Gooey Thread
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.

cards.name: Cherrim

attacks.name: Worry Seed
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Magical Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage and remove 3 damage counters from Cherrim.

cards.flavorText: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

cards.name: Drifloon

attacks.name: Blowing Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Ominous Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused and can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

cards.name: Dusclops

attacks.name: Roam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon. If tails, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gravity Wave
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that doesn't have a Retreat Cost. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

cards.name: Elekid

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Electabuzz from your hand onto Elekid (this counts as evolving Elekid) and remove all damage counters from Elekid.

attacks.name: Outlet
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Lightning Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can't store the energy it makes.

cards.name: Grotle

attacks.name: Synthesis
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

cards.name: Haunter

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Dream Eater
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is not Asleep, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.

cards.name: Hippopotas

attacks.name: Yawn
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

cards.name: Luxio

attacks.name: Fasten Claws
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Thunder Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

cards.name: Machoke

attacks.name: Karate Chop
attacks.text: Does 40 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on Machoke.

cards.flavorText: MACHOKE's boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.

cards.name: Magneton

attacks.name: Tri Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Magnetic Ray
attacks.text: Before doing damage, you may choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any Energy attached to it and switch that Pokémon with 1 of the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.

cards.name: Mantyke

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Mantine from your hand onto Mantyke (this counts as evolving Mantyke) and remove all damage counters from Mantyke.

attacks.name: Call for Friends
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Water Basic Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

cards.name: Monferno

attacks.name: Flame Dance
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a Fire Energy card and attach it to Monferno.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.

cards.name: Nuzleaf

attacks.name: Dirty Trick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Razor Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

cards.name: Aggron

attacks.name: Heap Up
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for all Energy cards and show them to your opponent. If you find any Metal Special Energy cards there this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage. Put all of those Energy cards on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Hard Metal
attacks.text: You may do 60 damage plus 40 more damage. If you do, Aggron does 40 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

cards.name: Alakazam

abilities.name: Power Cancel
abilities.text: Once during your opponent's turn, when your opponent's Pokémon uses any Poké-Power, you may discard 2 cards from your hand and prevent all effects of that Poké-Power. (This counts as that Pokémon using its Poké-Power.) This power can't be used if Alakazam is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psychic Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Alakazam by attacks from your opponent's Stage 2 Evolved Pokémon is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Its superb memory lets it recall everything it has experienced from birth. Its IQ exceeds 5,000.

cards.name: Ambipom

attacks.name: Tail Influence
attacks.text: Your opponent flips a coin until he or she gets heads. For each tails, remove an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and put it on the bottom of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Charity Tail
attacks.text: Before Ambipom does damage, your opponent may discard 2 cards from his or her hand. If he or she does, this attack's base damage is 10 instead of 80.

cards.flavorText: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

cards.name: Azelf

abilities.name: Downer Material
abilities.text: If you have Uxie and Mesprit in play, the attack cost of each of your opponent's Basic Pokémon's attacks is Colorless more. You can't use more than 1 Downer Material Poké-Body each turn.

attacks.name: Bind Pulse
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, your opponent can't attach any Special Energy cards from his or her hand to any of his or her Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

cards.name: Blissey

abilities.name: Kind Egg
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Happiny is anywhere under Blissey, you may choose a number of cards in your hand up to the amount of Energy attached to Blissey and put those cards on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. Then, draw that many cards. This power can't be used if Blissey is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Happy Chance
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 for each Energy attached to Blissey. Before doing damage, you may search your discard pile for a basic Energy card and attach it to Blissey.

cards.flavorText: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.

cards.name: Bronzong

abilities.name: Miracle Oracle
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw a card. Then, discard a card from your hand. If you discard an Energy card, draw 1 more card. This power can't be used if Bronzong is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Shady Stamp
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

cards.name: Celebi

attacks.name: Sprouting
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to Celebi. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Leaf Tornado
attacks.text: You may move any number of basic Grass Energy cards attached to your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: It has the power to travel across time, but is is said to appear only in peaceful times.

cards.name: Feraligatr

attacks.name: Energy Cyclone
attacks.text: Choose as many Energy cards from your hand as you like and show them to your opponent. This attack does 20 damage times the number of Energy cards you chose. Put those Energy cards on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Breaking Tail
attacks.text: Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it.

cards.flavorText: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

cards.name: Garchomp

abilities.name: Rainbow Scale
abilities.text: If an Active Pokémon has Weakness to any of the types of Energy attached to Garchomp, Garchomp's attacks do 40 more damage to that Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). Rainbow Scale Poké-Body can't be used if Garchomp has any Special Energy cards attached to it.

cards.flavorText: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

cards.name: Honchkrow

abilities.name: Dark Genes
abilities.text: As long as Honchkrow has the Energy necessary to use its attack, each of your Murkrow can use Honchkrow's attack as its own without the Energy necessary to use that attack.

attacks.name: Dark Wing Flaps
attacks.text: Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking. Look at the card you chose, then have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck.

cards.flavorText: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.

cards.name: Lumineon

abilities.name: Lure Ring
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Lumineon is your Active Pokémon, you may choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has a maximum HP of 100 or more and switch it with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. This power can't be used if Lumineon is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Reverse Stream
