attacks.name: Magma Storm
attacks.text: You may discard as many basic Energy cards as you like attached to Heatran. If you do, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage for each Energy card you discarded.

cards.flavorText: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

cards.name: Kingdra

attacks.name: Aqua Stream
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for as many Water Energy cards as you like, show them to your opponent, and this attack does 10 damage for each Water Energy card you chose. Put those cards on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Dragon Pump
attacks.text: You may discard 2 cards from your hand. If you do, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage and does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.

cards.name: Luxray

abilities.name: Rivalry
abilities.text: If your opponent has any Pokémon LV.X in play, each of Luxray's attacks does 50 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Plasma
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to Luxray.

attacks.name: Shock Bolt
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy attached to Luxray.

cards.flavorText: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

cards.name: Mamoswine

attacks.name: Ice Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Charge Through
attacks.text: You may do 60 damage plus 40 more damage and 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If you do, Mamoswine does 40 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

cards.name: Metagross

abilities.name: Magnetic Reversal
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. This power can't be used if Metagross is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Extra Comet Punch
attacks.text: During your next turn, Metagross's Extra Comet Punch attack's base damage is 100.

cards.flavorText: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

cards.name: Mewtwo

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.name: Politoed

abilities.name: Enthusiasm
abilities.text: If you have Poliwag, Poliwhirl, and Poliwrath in play, each of these Pokémon's attacks does 60 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Frog Hop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make Poliwag obey.

cards.name: Probopass

abilities.name: Steel Coating
abilities.text: Any damage done to Probopass by your opponent's attacks is reduced by 10 for each Metal Energy attached to Probopass (after applying Weakness and Resistance). You can't reduce more than 20 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Metal Bomber
attacks.text: Choose a number of your opponent's Benched Pokémon up to the amount of Metal Energy attached to Probopass. This attack does 20 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units call Mini-Noses.

cards.name: Rayquaza

abilities.name: Speed Gain
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, search your discard pile for a basic Fire Energy card or a basic Lightning Energy card and attach it to Rayquaza. This power can't be used if Rayquaza is affected by a Special Condition or if you have another Rayquaza in play.

attacks.name: Sky Judgement
attacks.text: Discard all Energy attached to Rayquaza.

cards.flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

cards.name: Regigigas

abilities.name: Slow Start
abilities.text: Regigigas can't attack until your opponent has 3 or less Prize cards left.

attacks.name: Crush Grip
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack's base damage is 40 instead of 120.

cards.flavorText: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

cards.name: Spiritomb

abilities.name: Curse Breath
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Spiritomb from your hand onto your Bench, you may put 1 damage counter on all Pokémon that already have any damage counters on them (both yours and your opponent's). You can't use more than 1 Curse Breath Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Transfer Pain
attacks.text: Move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

cards.name: Yanmega

attacks.name: Sonic Wave
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pursue and Turn
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has 2 or more damage counters on it, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage and switch Yanmega with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

cards.name: Armaldo

abilities.name: Fossil Armor
abilities.text: If Armaldo would be damaged by an attack, prevent that attack's damage done to Armaldo if that damage is 60 or less.

attacks.name: Crush Claw
attacks.text: During your next turn, if an attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.

cards.name: Azelf

abilities.name: Time Walk
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Azelf from your hand onto your Bench, you may look at all of your face-down Prize cards. If you do, you may choose 1 Pokémon you find there, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then, choose 1 card in your hand and put it as a Prize card face down.

attacks.name: Lock Up
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

cards.name: Bellossom

attacks.name: Parallel Gain
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Blend Pollen
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 20 more damage for each Vileplume and each Bellossom you have in play. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

cards.name: Cradily

attacks.name: Drain Down
attacks.text: Before doing damage, you may switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 30 damage to the new Defending Pokémon. If the Defending Pokémon would be Knocked Out by this attack, you may remove all damage counters from Cradily.

attacks.name: Acid
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

cards.name: Crawdaunt

attacks.name: Gripthrow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent returns the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it to his or her hand.

attacks.name: Prop-up Pinchers
attacks.text: If Crawdaunt has a Technical Machine card attached to it, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

cards.name: Delcatty

abilities.name: Attracting Body
abilities.text: If Delcatty is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Delcatty is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, the Attacking Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Energy Assist
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

cards.name: Deoxys Attack Forme

abilities.name: Form Change
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for any Deoxys and switch it with Deoxys Attack Forme. (Any cards attached to Deoxys Attack Forme, damage counters, Special Conditions, and effects on it are now on the new Pokémon.) If you do, put Deoxys Attack Forme on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't use more than 1 Form Change Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Psychic Boost
attacks.text: During your next turn, Deoxys's Psychic Boost attack's base damage is 20.

cards.flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Deoxys Defense Forme

abilities.name: Form Change
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for any Deoxys and switch it with Deoxys Defense Forme. (Any cards attached to Deoxys Defense Forme, damage counters, Special Conditions, and effects on it are now on the new Pokémon.) If you do, put Deoxys Defense Forme on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't use more than 1 Form Change Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Psychic Defense
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of an attack, and any damage done to Deoxys by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Deoxys Speed Forme

abilities.name: Form Change
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for any Deoxys and switch it with Deoxys Speed Forme. (Any cards attached to Deoxys Speed Forme, damage counters, Special Conditions, and effects on it are now on the new Pokémon.) If you do, put Deoxys Speed Forme on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't use more than 1 Form Change Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Speed Shot
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on that Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Ditto

abilities.name: Ditto DNA
abilities.text: As long as Ditto is your Active Pokémon, its maximum HP is the same as your opponent's Active Pokémon. Ditto can use the attacks of that Pokémon as its own. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.) If that Pokémon is no longer your opponent's Active Pokémon, choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon for Ditto to copy.

cards.flavorText: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.

cards.name: Forretress

abilities.name: Iron Shell
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a basic Energy card from your hand to Forretress (excluding effects of attacks), you may flip a coin. If tails, put 2 damage counters on each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) (excluding any Forretress).

attacks.name: Explosion
attacks.text: Forretress does 40 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.

cards.name: Groudon

attacks.name: Drought
attacks.text: Choose up to 2 basic Fighting Energy cards from your hand and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Major Earthquake
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fighting Energy attached to Groudon and this attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.

cards.name: Heatran

abilities.name: Smelt
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Metal Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to Heatran. This power can't be used if Heatran is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Heavy Metal
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Metal Energy attached to Heatran. This attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

cards.name: Jirachi

attacks.name: One Desire
attacks.text: Search your deck for any 1 card. Shuffle your deck, then put that card on top of your deck.

attacks.name: Doom Desire
attacks.text: Discard all Energy attached to Jirachi. The Defending Pokémon is Knocked Out at the end of your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Kyogre

attacks.name: Drizzle
attacks.text: Choose up to 2 basic Water Energy cards from your hand and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: High Tide
attacks.text: Discard 2 Water Energy attached to Kyogre. This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

cards.name: Lopunny

abilities.name: Healing Tail
abilities.text: As long as Lopunny is your Active Pokémon, remove 1 damage counter from each of your Benched Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Cross-Cut
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is an Evolved Pokémon, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

cards.name: Mesprit

abilities.name: Psychic Bind
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Mesprit from your hand onto your Bench, you may use this power. Your opponent can't use any Poké-Powers on his or her Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Extrasensory
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 20 damage plus 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

cards.name: Poliwrath

attacks.name: Focus Punch
attacks.text: If Poliwrath was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Submission
attacks.text: Poliwrath does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: With extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

cards.name: Regice

abilities.name: Regi Move
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this power. Discard 2 cards from your hand and choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon that isn't an Evolved Pokémon. Then, your opponent switches that Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. This power can't be used if Regice is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Ice Reflect
attacks.text: If Regice was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Regigigas

abilities.name: Recover Mechanism
abilities.text: When you attach an Energy card from your hand to Regigigas, remove all Special Conditions from Regigigas.

attacks.name: Gigaton Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage and does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

cards.name: Regirock

abilities.name: Regi Cycle
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have a Fighting Energy card in your discard pile, you may discard 2 cards from your hand. Then, attach a Fighting Energy card from your discard pile to Regirock. This power can't be used if Regirock is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Stone Edge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

cards.name: Registeel

abilities.name: Regi Heal
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard 2 cards from your hand. Then, remove 3 damage counters from Registeel. This power can't be used if Registeel is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Rotating Claws
attacks.text: You may discard an Energy card attached to Registeel. If you do, search your discard pile for an Energy card (excluding the one you discarded) and attach it to Registeel.

cards.flavorText: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

cards.name: Shedinja

abilities.name: Resent
abilities.text: Once during your opponent's turn, if Shedinja would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, you may put 4 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon and each of the opponent's Pokémon that has the same name as the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Curse and Deceive
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. If Shedinja has any damage counters on it, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.

cards.name: Torkoal

abilities.name: White Smoke
abilities.text: As long as Torkoal is your Active Pokémon, prevent all effects, including damage, done to your Benched Pokémon by your opponent's attacks.

attacks.name: Black Soot
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned and Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

cards.name: Unown [!]

abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Unown ! from your hand onto your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If tails, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hidden Power
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, Unown ! does 10 damage to itself, and this attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Shaped like an ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Uxie

abilities.name: Set Up
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Uxie from your hand onto your Bench, you may draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Psychic Restore
attacks.text: You may put Uxie and all cards attached to it on the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

cards.name: Victreebel

attacks.name: Burning Scent
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned and Poisoned. Before applying these effects, you may switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon is now Burned and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Energy Dissolve
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon at the end of your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.

cards.name: Vileplume

abilities.name: Energy Reaction
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you attach a Grass or Psychic Energy card from your hand to Vileplume (excluding effects of attacks or Poké-Powers), you may use this power. If you attach a Grass Energy card, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If you attach a Psychic Energy card, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. This power can't be used if Vileplume is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Disturbing Pollen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Trainer, Supporter, or Stadium cards from his or her hand during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.

cards.name: Anorith

attacks.name: Guard Claw
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Anorith by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: X-Scissor
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

cards.name: Camerupt

attacks.name: Eruption
attacks.text: Each player discards the top of his or her deck. This attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage for each Energy card discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Camerupt does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.

cards.name: Castform

abilities.name: Temperament
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for any Castform and switch it with Castform. (Any cards attached to Castform, damage counters, Special Conditions, and effects on it are now on the new Pokémon.) If you do, put Castform on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't use more than 1 Temperament Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Weather Ball
attacks.text: If you have a Stadium card in play, remove 3 damage counters from Castform. If your opponent has a Stadium card in play, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

cards.name: Castform Rain Form

abilities.name: Temperament
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for any Castform and switch it with Castform Rain Form. (Any cards attached to Castform Rain Form, damage counters, Special Conditions, and effects on it are now on the new Pokémon.) Shuffle Castform Rain Form back into your deck. You can't use more than 1 Temperament Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Water Pulse
attacks.text: The defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

cards.name: Castform Snow-Cloud Form

abilities.name: Temperament
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for any Castform and switch it with Castform Snow-cloud Form. (Any cards attached to Castform Snow-cloud Form, damage counters, Special Conditions, and effects on it are now on the new Pokémon.) Shuffle Castform Snow-cloud Form back into your deck. You can't use more than 1 Temperament Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Hail
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

cards.name: Castform Sunny Form

abilities.name: Temperament
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for any Castform and switch it with Castform Sunny Form. (Any cards attached to Castform Sunny Form, damage counters, Special Conditions, and effects on it are now on the new Pokémon.) Shuffle Castform Sunny Form back into your deck. You can't use more than 1 Temperament Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy attached to Castform Sunny Form.

cards.flavorText: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

abilities.name: Shadow Command
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw 2 cards. If you have 7 or more cards in your hand, discard a number of cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. Then, put 2 damage counters on Dusknoir. This power can't be used if Dusknoir is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Damage Even
attacks.text: Count the number of damage counters on Dusknoir. Put that many damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Night Spin
attacks.text: Prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Dusknoir by your opponent's Pokémon that has 2 or less Energy attached to it during your opponent's next turn.

abilities.name: Emperor Aura
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you play Empoleon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Active Pokémon, you may use this power. Your opponent can't attach any Energy cards from his or her hand to his or her Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Steel Wing
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Empoleon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Whirlpool
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

abilities.name: Blaze Dance
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you play Infernape from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for up to 4 Fire Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Close Combat
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Infernape by attacks is increased by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Spreading Fire
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy attached to Infernape and this attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Fin Luster
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Lumineon is your Active Pokémon, you may look at your opponent's hand. If your opponent's Bench isn't full, choose 1 Basic Pokémon from your opponent's hand, and put it onto his or her Bench. Then, switch it with the Defending Pokémon. This power can't be used if Lumineon is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Quick Swim
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Elegant Swim
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Lumineon during your opponent's next turn.

abilities.name: Magnetic Search
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Lightning or Metal Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Magnezone is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Speed Shot
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Crush Volt
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to Magnezone.

cards.name: Magnezone

abilities.name: Super Connectivity
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your discard pile for a Lightning or Metal Energy card and attach it to your Active Pokémon. Then, put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Magnezone is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Gyro Ball
attacks.text: You may switch Magnezone with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

attacks.name: Crash Chant
attacks.text: Choose up to 4 in any combination of Pokémon Tool cards and Technical Machine cards in play (both yours and your opponent's) and discard them. This attack does 20 damage times the number of cards discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Horror Chant
attacks.text: If your opponent has 4 or more Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and return that Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Slice
attacks.text: Raichu can't use Slice during your next turn.

attacks.name: Split Ball
attacks.text: Move an Energy card attached to Raichu to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Burst Ball
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy attached to any of your Pokémon in any way you like.

abilities.name: Regi Form
abilities.text: If you have Regirock, Regice, and Registeel in play, the attack cost of Regigigas's attacks is Colorless less.

attacks.name: Giga Power
attacks.text: You may do 60 damage plus 40 more damage. If you do, Regigigas does 40 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Energy Trans
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), move a Grass Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Sceptile is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of those Energy cards and discard it.

attacks.name: Water Punch
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Water Energy attached to Misty's Poliwhirl. This attack does 30 damage plus 10 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Call for Friend
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, you may search your deck for a Basic Pokémon with Misty in its name and put it onto your Bench. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.text: Blaine's Arcanine does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Firestorm
attacks.text: Discard 3 Fire Energy cards attached to Blaine's Arcanine in order to use this attack.

attacks.name: Roaring Flames
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy cards attached to Blaine's Charizard. If all Energy cards attached to Blaine's Charizard provide 2 Fire Energy, discard all of them. This attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each Fire Energy discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Flame Jet
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

abilities.name: Shapeshift
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach an Evolution card from your hand to Brock's Ninetales. (This doesn't count as evolving Brock's Ninetales.) Treat Brock's Ninetales as if it were that Pokémon instead. It can't evolve, devolve, or use the Pokémon Power of that Pokémon. During your turn, you may discard the Evolution card attached to Brock's Ninetales. This power can't be used if Brock's Ninetales is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. If Brock's Ninetales becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed, discard all Evolution cards attached to it.

attacks.name: Growth
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, you may attach up to 2 Grass Energy cards from your hand to Erika's Venusaur.

attacks.name: Wide Solarbeam
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 2 of them (or 1 if he or she only has 1). This attack does 20 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Summon Storm
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 20 damage to each other Pokémon (even your own). Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack.

attacks.name: Dragon Tornado
attacks.text: Unless this attack Knocks Out the Defending Pokémon, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

abilities.name: Fortitude
abilities.text: If Giovanni's Machamp would be Knocked Out by an opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, Giovanni's Machamp is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead. This power can't be used if Giovanni's Machamp is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Hurricane Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Intimidate
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon's maximum HP is 50 or less, it can't attack Giovanni's Nidoking during your opponent's next turn. (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Tumbling Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage; if tails, this attack does 40 damage.

abilities.name: Call the Boss
abilities.text: When you play Giovanni's Persian from your hand, you may search your deck for the Trainer card named Giovanni, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Nerve Poison
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Hyper Needle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. Either way, you can't use this attack again as long as Koga's Beedrill stays in play (even putting Koga's Beedrill on the Bench won't let you use it again).

attacks.name: Giant Growth
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, Koga's Ditto's maximum HP is now 80 and Koga's Ditto's Pound attack's base damage is 30 instead of 10. (Benching Koga's Ditto ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Kerzap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 30 more damage to the Defending Pokémon and discard all Lightning Energy cards attached to Lt. Surge's Raichu. If tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Thundertackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, Lt. Surge's Raichu does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Electro Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Energy cards attached to Misty's Golduck.

attacks.name: Super Removal
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any Energy cards and discard those Energy cards.

abilities.name: Rebellion
abilities.text: Whenever Misty's Gyarados attacks, flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, that attack does nothing. Instead, shuffle Misty's Gyarados and all cards attached to it into your deck. (This power works even if Misty's Gyarados is Confused.)

attacks.name: Juxtapose
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, switch the number of damage counters on Rocket's Mewtwo with the number of damage counters on the Defending Pokémon (even if it would Knock Out either Pokémon). (It's okay if 1 of the Pokémon has no damage counters on it.)

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Plasma
attacks.text: If there are any Lightning Energy cards in your discard pile, attach 1 of them to Rocket's Zapdos.

attacks.name: Electroburn
attacks.text: Rocket's Zapdos does damage to itself equal to 10 times the number of Lightning Energy cards attached to it.

abilities.name: Psylink
abilities.text: Sabrina's Alakazam always has a copy of every attack your Psychic Pokémon in play have (including their Energy costs and anything else required in order to use those attacks, such as discarding Energy cards). This power can't be used if Sabrina's Alakazam is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Mega Burn
attacks.text: You can't use this attack during your next turn.

cards.name: Blaine
rules: During this turn, instead of attaching your free Energy card, you may instead attach 2 Fire Energy cards to 1 of your Pokémon with Blaine in its name. (Playing additional copies of this card this turn has no effect.)

cards.name: Giovanni
rules: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play with Giovanni in its name. For the rest of your turn, you may evolve that Pokémon even if you just played or evolved it this turn or if this is your first turn. This effect also applies to the Pokémon it evolves into.

cards.name: Koga
rules: If an attack from a Pokémon with Koga in its name does damage to a Defending Pokémon this turn, that Pokémon is then Poisoned.

cards.name: Sabrina
rules: Take all Energy cards attached to 1 of your Pokémon with Sabrina in its name and attach them to another 1 of your Pokémon with Sabrina in its name.

abilities.name: Healing Fire
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Fire Energy card from your hand to Blaine's Ninetales, remove 1 damage counter from it, if it has any. This power stops working when Blaine's Ninetales is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Burn Up
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Fire Energy cards attached to Blaine's Ninetales.

attacks.name: Lie Low
attacks.text: All damage done to Brock's Dugtrio during your opponent's next turn is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Earthdrill
attacks.text: This attack can't be used unless Brock's Dugtrio used its Lie Low attack last turn.

attacks.name: Love Lariat
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 50 more damage if you have at least 1 Giovanni's Nidoking on your Bench. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Snapping Pincers
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Overhead Toss
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If tails, choose 1 of your Benched Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Poison Buildup
attacks.text: Koga's Arbok is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Poison Power
attacks.text: If Koga's Arbok is Poisoned, this attack's base damage is 40 instead of 20 and the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

abilities.name: Energy Drain
abilities.text: If an opponent's attack does damage to Koga's Muk (even if Koga's Muk is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads and if it has any, choose 1 Energy card attached to the attacking Pokémon and discard it. This power can't be used if Koga's Muk is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed when your opponent attacks.

attacks.name: Quick Turn
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Aerial Maneuvers
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage, and, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Koga's Pidgeotto. If tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: High Voltage
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play Trainer cards during his or her next turn.

attacks.name: Thunder Flare
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Lt. Surge's Jolteon, then flip a coin. If tails, Lt. Surge's Jolteon does 30 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Dark Wave
attacks.text: All Pokémon Powers stop working until the end of your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Shadow Bind
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Damage Shift
attacks.text: Move 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon that has any on it to the Defending Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.)

attacks.name: Water Spray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Bonfire
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Blaine's Charmeleon. If you can't discard Energy cards, this attack does nothing. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads to each of your opponent's Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

attacks.name: Mega Peck
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Stamp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage (to the Defending Pokémon) and 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If tails, this attack does 30 damage (to the Defending Pokémon).

attacks.name: Detonate
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each Pokémon on each player's bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Brock's Graveler does 50 damage to itself. If there is a Stadium card in play, discard it.

abilities.name: Scram
abilities.text: If Brock's Primeape ever has exactly 10 HP left, shuffle it and all cards attached to it into your deck. This power stops working while Brock's Primeape is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Mega Thrash
attacks.text: Brock's Primeape does 20 damage to itself. If there is a Stadium card in play, discard it.

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokémon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Needle Ball
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Hypnotic Gaze
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Fire Ring
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Soak Up
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may take up to 2 Grass Energy cards attached to your other Pokémon and attach them to Erika's Bellsprout. This power can't be used if Erika's Bellsprout is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Stretch Vine
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon, and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Sleep Seed
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Errand-Running
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, you may search your deck for a Trainer card. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Lunar Power
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card that evolves from 1 of your Benched Pokémon and put that card on that Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

abilities.name: Relaxing Scent
abilities.text: As long as Erika's Ivysaur is your Active Pokémon, whenever an attack (even your own) does damage to any Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack only does half the damage to that Pokémon (rounded up to the nearest 10). (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) This power stops working while Erika's Ivysaur is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Double Razor Leaf
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Risky Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does no damage to the Defending Pokémon and Giovanni's Machoke does 100 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Headlock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: False Charity
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, look at the top card of your opponent's deck. If it's a Trainer card, put it in your opponent's discard pile; otherwise, put it into his or her hand.

attacks.name: Double Scratch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Poison Sting Tackle
attacks.text: Giovanni's Nidorina does 20 damage to itself. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Rend
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. If not, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Sonic Scream
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

abilities.name: Emerge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for an Evolution card named Koga's Beedrill and put it on Koga's Kakuna. (This counts as evolving Koga's Kakuna.) Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Koga's Kakuna is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Toxic Secretion
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned).

attacks.name: Smokescreen
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Obscuring Gas
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, shuffle Koga's Koffing and all cards attached to it into your deck (after doing damage).

attacks.name: Messenger
attacks.text: Put Koga's Pidgey and all cards attached to it on top of your deck. Then search your deck for any Basic Pokémon or Evolution card not named Koga's Pidgey. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Spontaneous Explosion
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage and Koga's Weezing does 30 damage to itself; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Toxic Cloud
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned).

attacks.name: Surprise
attacks.text: Look at a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck.

abilities.name: Shock Blast
abilities.text: If Lt. Surge's Electrode is your Active Pokémon and gets damaged (even if it's Knocked Out), flip a coin. If tails, this power does 20 damage to each Active Pokémon. This power works even if Lt. Surge's Electrode is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed when it takes damage.

attacks.name: Power Ball
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Focus Energy
attacks.text: During your next turn, Lt. Surge's Raticate's Double-edge attack's damage (base damage and damage to itself) is doubled.

attacks.name: Double-edge
attacks.text: Lt. Surge's Raticate does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Ice Throw
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Fighting, this attack's base damage is doubled.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Misty's Dewgong does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Nightmare
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Shadow Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, and if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 30 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Invigorate
attacks.text: Choose 1 Basic Pokémon in any player's discard pile. Put it onto that player's Bench. Put a number of damage counters on that Pokémon equal to half its HP (rounded down to the nearest 10). (You can't put a Pokémon on a Bench that's full.)

attacks.name: Pendulum Curse
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Helping Hand
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Remove any number of damage counters from that Pokémon, then draw that many cards.

attacks.name: Hug
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is considered magnificent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.

cards.name: Azumarill

attacks.name: Bubblebeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

cards.name: Clefable

attacks.name: Fairy Power
attacks.text: Return 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

cards.flavorText: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.

cards.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

cards.name: Hitmontop

attacks.name: Triple Kick
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Close Combat
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Hitmontop by attacks is increased by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

cards.name: Jumpluff

attacks.name: Mass Attack
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Leaf Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Jumpluff by attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores—it can even float around the world.

cards.name: Ninetales

abilities.name: Roast Reveal
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Fire Energy card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards. This power can't be used if Ninetales is affected by a Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: Its nine beautiful tails are filled with a wondrous energy that could keep it alive for 1,000 years.

cards.name: Noctowl

abilities.name: Night Sight
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw a card. This power can't be used if Noctowl is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Extrasensory
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 40 damage plus 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

cards.name: Quagsire

attacks.name: Muddy Water
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

cards.name: Raichu

attacks.name: Iron Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy attached to Raichu.

cards.flavorText: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

cards.name: Shuckle

abilities.name: Shell Barricade
abilities.text: As long as Shuckle is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to Shuckle by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: The berries it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

cards.name: Slowking

abilities.name: Second Sight
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at the top 3 cards of that player's deck and put them back on top of that player's deck in any order. This power can't be used if Slowking is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

cards.name: Wobbuffet

attacks.name: Double Return
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage times the number of damage counters on Wobbuffet.

cards.flavorText: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

cards.name: Ampharos

attacks.name: Acceleration Bolt
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Ampharos does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

cards.name: Ariados

attacks.name: Leech Life
attacks.text: Remove from Ariados the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poisonous Saliva
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It's hard to tell which end is which.

cards.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Cure Powder
attacks.text: Remove 3 damage counters from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Water-repellent powder on its wings enables it to collect honey, even in the heaviest of rains.

cards.name: Cleffa

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Cleffa is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Cleffa by attacks.

attacks.name: Eeeeeeek
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 6 cards. Cleffa is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Exeggutor

attacks.name: Energy Absorption
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 2 Energy cards and attach them to Exeggutor.

attacks.name: Big Eggsplosion
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to Exeggutor. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: If a head drops off, it emits a telepathic call in search of others to form an Exeggcute cluster.

cards.name: Farfetch'd

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Spin Turn
attacks.text: Switch Farfetch'd with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If it eats the plant stalk it carries as emergency rations, it runs off in search of a new stalk.

cards.name: Feraligatr

attacks.name: Spinning Tail
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

cards.name: Furret

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Quick Blow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

cards.name: Granbull

attacks.name: Timid Tackle
attacks.text: Granbull does 20 damage to itself. Switch Granbull with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Chomp
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Granbull.

cards.flavorText: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its bite is powerful.

cards.name: Hypno

abilities.name: Sleep Pendulum
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. This power can't be used if Hypno is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psychic Shot
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

cards.name: Lapras

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Ice Blade
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.

cards.name: Ledian

attacks.name: Quick Draw
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The spot patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

cards.name: Meganium

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Giant Bloom
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from Meganium.

cards.flavorText: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

cards.name: Persian

attacks.name: Sharpen Claws
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, discard a card from your opponent's hand without looking.

attacks.name: Sneaky Attack
attacks.text: If Persian has any Darkness Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

cards.name: Pichu

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Pichu is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Pichu by attacks.

attacks.name: Playground
attacks.text: Each player may search his or her deck for as many Basic Pokémon as he or she likes, put them onto his or her Bench, and shuffle his or her deck afterward. (You put your Pokémon on the Bench first.) Pichu is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

cards.name: Sandslash

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: If it digs at an incredible pace, it may snap off its spike and claws. They grow back in a day.

cards.name: Smoochum

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Smoochum is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Smoochum by attacks.

attacks.name: Energy Antics
attacks.text: Move an Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon. Smoochum is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

cards.name: Sunflora

abilities.name: Sunshine Grace
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Grass Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Sunflora is affected by a Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

cards.name: Typhlosion

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy attached to Typhlosion.

cards.flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

cards.name: Tyrogue

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Tyrogue is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Tyrogue by attacks.

attacks.name: Mischievous Punch
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. Tyrogue is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

cards.name: Weezing

attacks.name: Super Poison Breath
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Super Explosion
attacks.text: Weezing does 90 damage to itself, and don't apply Weakness to this damage.

cards.flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Bayleef
cards.flavorText: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

cards.name: Blissey

attacks.name: Energy Link
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for an Energy card and attach it to Blissey.

attacks.name: Double-edge
attacks.text: Blissey does 40 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey's egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

cards.name: Corsola

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard a Water Energy attached to Corsola and remove all damage counters from Corsola.

attacks.name: Hyper Cannon
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

cards.name: Croconaw

attacks.name: Big Bite
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

cards.name: Delibird

attacks.name: Snowy Present
attacks.text: Draw a card for each Water Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hail
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.

cards.name: Donphan

attacks.name: Rock Hurl
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Double Spin
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

cards.name: Dunsparce

attacks.name: Glare
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fade Out
attacks.text: Return Dunsparce and all cards attached to it to your hand.

cards.flavorText: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

cards.name: Flaaffy

attacks.name: Thunder Spear
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

cards.name: Heracross

attacks.name: Green Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card for each of your Grass Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Double Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

cards.name: Igglybuff

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Igglybuff is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Igglybuff by attacks.

attacks.name: Graffiti
attacks.text: Igglybuff is now Asleep. During your opponent's next turn, the attack cost of each of the Defending Pokémon's attacks is Colorless more.

cards.flavorText: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously—anytime, anywhere.

cards.name: Mantine

attacks.name: Group Swim
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Water Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Aqua Slash
attacks.text: Mantine can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if Remoraid attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

cards.name: Metapod

abilities.name: Green Shield
abilities.text: Each of your Grass Pokémon has no Weakness.

cards.flavorText: It prepares for evolution by hardening its shell as much as possible to protect its soft body.

cards.name: Miltank

attacks.name: Moomoo Squeeze
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Moomoo Milk card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: If it is around babies, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

cards.name: Parasect

attacks.name: Sleep Drain
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. Remove 4 damage counters from Parasect.

cards.flavorText: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

cards.name: Quilava

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to Quilava.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

cards.name: Qwilfish

attacks.name: Offensive Needle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

cards.name: Skiploom

attacks.name: Knock Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

cards.name: Slowbro

attacks.name: Big Yawn
attacks.text: Both Slowbro and the Defending Pokémon are now Asleep.

attacks.name: Madkinesis
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Psychic Energy attached to Slowbro.

cards.flavorText: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

cards.name: Starmie

attacks.name: Cosmic Cyclone
attacks.text: Choose as many Water Energy attached to your Pokémon as you like. This attack does 20 damage times the number of Energy you chose. Shuffle those cards back into your deck.

cards.flavorText: The middle section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

cards.name: Unown

abilities.name: RETURN
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Unown from your hand onto your Bench, you may return all Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to your hand.

cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Unown

abilities.name: FLASH
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Unown from your hand onto your Bench, you may look at the top 5 cards of your deck and put them back on top of your deck in any order.

cards.flavorText: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

cards.name: Wigglytuff

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Expand
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Wigglytuff by attacks is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a Body Slam.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: Its feet have suction cups designed to stick to any surface. It tenaciously climbs trees to forage.

cards.name: Chansey

attacks.name: Happy Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove 3 damage counters from Chansey.

cards.flavorText: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.flavorText: Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

cards.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Minimize
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Clefairy by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.flavorText: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

cards.name: Jirachi

abilities.name: Stardust Song
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Jirachi from your hand onto your Bench, you may flip 3 coins. For each heads, search your discard pile for a Psychic Energy card and attach it to Jirachi.

attacks.name: Time Hollow
attacks.text: Choose a number of your opponent's Stage 1 or Stage 2 Evolved Pokémon up to the amount of Energy attached to Jirachi. Remove the highest Stage Evolution card from each of those Pokémon and put those cards back into your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

cards.name: Magmortar

attacks.name: Hard Crush
attacks.text: Discard the top 3 cards from your deck. This attack does 50 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded.

attacks.name: Mantle Bazooka
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy attached to Magmortar.

cards.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

cards.name: Manaphy

attacks.name: Deep Sea Swirl
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 5 cards.

cards.flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

abilities.name: Psychic Float
abilities.text: If you have any Psychic Energy attached to your Active Pokémon, the Retreat Cost for that Pokémon is 0.

attacks.name: Double Leg Hammer
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Mismagius

abilities.name: Magical Trans
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Psychic Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Mismagius is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psychic Pulse
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

cards.name: Octillery

attacks.name: Switch Cannon
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Switch Octillery with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Ink Bomb
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

cards.name: Politoed

abilities.name: Leap Frog
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose a Water Pokémon on your Bench and switch it with your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Politoed is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Big Chorus
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Water Pokémon you have in play. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

cards.name: Shaymin

abilities.name: Celebration Wind
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Shaymin from your hand onto your Bench, you may move as many Energy cards attached to your Pokémon as you like to any of your other Pokémon.

attacks.name: Energy Bloom
attacks.text: Remove 3 damage counters from each of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached to it.

cards.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Sudowoodo

attacks.name: Push Over
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the amount of Fighting Energy attached to Sudowoodo.

attacks.name: Rumble
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

cards.name: Torterra

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: Remove from Torterra the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

cards.name: Xatu

attacks.name: Psywave
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

cards.name: Beedrill

attacks.name: Twineedle
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Paralyze Poison
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is also Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.

cards.name: Blastoise

abilities.name: Wash Out
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Water Energy attached to 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Blastoise is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hydro Launcher
attacks.text: Return 2 Water Energy attached to Blastoise to your hand. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 100 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

cards.name: Crobat

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Hurricane Wing
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

cards.name: Fearow

attacks.name: Repeating Drill
attacks.text: Flip 5 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.

cards.name: Floatzel

abilities.name: Water Acceleration
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Water Energy card from your hand to Floatzel. This power can't be used if Floatzel is affected by a Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

cards.name: Kingdra

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Stream Pump
attacks.text: You may do 50 damage plus 30 more damage. If you do, return an Energy card attached to Kingdra to your hand.

cards.flavorText: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

cards.name: Lanturn

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Reflect Energy
attacks.text: Move an Energy card attached to Lanturn to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

cards.name: Lucario

attacks.name: Bulk Up
attacks.text: During your next turn, each of Lucario's attacks does 30 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras, even foes it could not otherwise see.

cards.name: Ninetales

attacks.name: Heat Acceleration
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 3 Fire Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

cards.name: Poliwrath

attacks.name: Steamroll
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Dynamic Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 damage plus 40 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.

cards.name: Primeape

attacks.name: Bebop Punch
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.

cards.name: Roserade

abilities.name: Energy Signal
abilities.text: When you attach a Grass Energy card or Psychic Energy card from your hand to Roserade during your turn, you may use this power. If you attach a Grass Energy card, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If you attach a Psychic Energy card, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. This power can't be used if Roserade is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Power Blow
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to Roserade.

cards.flavorText: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.

cards.name: Steelix

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Steelix by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Steel Swing
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage times the number of heads.
