cards.flavorText: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

cards.name: Torkoal

abilities.name: Hot Snort
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Torkoal from your hand onto your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

cards.name: Tyranitar

attacks.name: Tail Crush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It has an insolent nature that makes it not care about others.

cards.name: Ursaring

attacks.name: Cross Chop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailing finds all food buried deep underground.

cards.name: Cherrim

abilities.name: Sunny Heal
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may remove 1 damage counter from your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Cherrim is affected by a Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.

cards.name: Dunsparce

attacks.name: Return
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

cards.flavorText: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

cards.name: Golbat

attacks.name: Mean Look
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

cards.name: Grotle

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

cards.name: Kakuna

attacks.name: Speed Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from Kakuna and put it onto Kakuna. (This counts as evolving Kakuna.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.

cards.name: Metang

attacks.name: Energy Crane
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 2 Psychic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

cards.name: Minun

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Tag Team Boost
attacks.text: If Plusle is on your Bench, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

cards.name: Numel

attacks.name: Flare Bonus
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy card from your hand. Then, draw 3 cards.

cards.flavorText: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.

cards.name: Plusle

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Plusle does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

cards.name: Poliwhirl

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: The skin on most of its body is moist. However, the skin on its belly spiral feels smooth.

cards.name: Pupitar

abilities.name: Boost Gas
abilities.text: If Pupitar has any Energy attached to it, the Retreat Cost of Pupitar is 0.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Pupitar.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.flavorText: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

cards.name: Seadra

attacks.name: Muddy Water
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its fin tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.

cards.name: Tauros

attacks.name: Crimson Bull
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. Tauros is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns.

cards.name: Wartortle

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It is a well-established symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

cards.name: Aipom

attacks.name: Tail Code
attacks.text: Move an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tail Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

cards.name: Beldum

attacks.name: Reaction
attacks.text: You may switch Beldum with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground's natural magnetism, letting it float.

cards.name: Buizel

attacks.name: Muddy Water
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

cards.name: Carnivine

attacks.name: Drawup Power
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.flavorText: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

cards.name: Horsea

attacks.name: Fin Smack
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Its big, developed fins move rapidly, allowing it to swim backward while still facing forward.

cards.name: Larvitar

attacks.name: Mountain Eater
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. Then, remove 2 damage counters from Larvitar.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: Larvitar does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.flavorText: It is born deep underground. It can't emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

cards.name: Mankey

attacks.name: Karate Chop
attacks.text: Does 40 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on Mankey.

cards.flavorText: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.

cards.name: Misdreavus

attacks.name: Sharpshooting
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

cards.name: Bellossom

abilities.name: Hustle Step
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Bellossom is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Dance 'til Dawn
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. Bellossom is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Bellossom gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

cards.name: Espeon

attacks.name: Solar Suggestion
attacks.text: Move up to 4 damage counters from any of your Pokémon to any of your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.

cards.name: Forretress

attacks.name: Mirror Shot
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Everyone Explode Now
attacks.text: Does 30 damage times the number of Pineco and Forretress you have in play. This attack does 30 damage to each of your Pineco and Forretress in play.

cards.flavorText: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

cards.name: Gliscor

attacks.name: Ninja Fang
attacks.text: If, before Gliscor does damage, the Defending Pokémon has no damage counters on it and is then damaged by this attack (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey… Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

cards.name: Houndoom

attacks.name: Fire Counterattack
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Fighting Pokémon in play, this attack does 20 damage plus 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Dark Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent discards a card from his or her hand.

cards.flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

cards.name: Magcargo

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Lava Flow
attacks.text: You may discard any number of Fire Energy cards attached to Magcargo. If you do , this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage for each Fire Energy card you discarded.

cards.flavorText: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.flavorText: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

cards.name: Smeargle

abilities.name: Portrait
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Smeargle is your Active Pokémon, you may look at your opponent's hand. If you do, choose a Supporter card you find there and use the effect of that card as the effect of this power. This power can't be used if Smeargle is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Tail Rap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

cards.name: Togekiss

attacks.name: Blessed Wings
attacks.text: Remove all damage counters from each of your Pokémon. Shuffle Togekiss and all cards attached to it back into your deck.

attacks.name: Air Cutter
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

cards.name: Umbreon

attacks.name: Moonlight Fang
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects, including damage, done to Umbreon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that has any Poké-Powers or Poké-Bodies.

attacks.name: Quick Blow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 damage.

cards.flavorText: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

cards.name: Dodrio

abilities.name: Retreat Aid
abilities.text: As long as Dodrio is on your Bench, your Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is ColorlessColorless less.

attacks.name: Incessant Peck
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and fall into a state of immobility.

cards.name: Drifblim

attacks.name: Balloon Tackle
attacks.text: Drifblim does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Take Away
attacks.text: Shuffle Drifblim and all cards attached to it back into your deck. Then, your opponent shuffles the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it into his or her deck. (You choose your new Active Pokémon first.)

cards.flavorText: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

cards.name: Forretress

attacks.name: Spike Spread
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Gyro Ball
attacks.text: You may switch Forretress with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

cards.name: Hariyama

attacks.name: Backward Belt Throw
attacks.text: You may do 80 damage plus 20 more damage. If you do, Hariyama does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

cards.name: Honchkrow

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Blindside
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. This attack does 50 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

cards.name: Honchkrow

attacks.name: Shadow Bind
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Vengeance
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Darkness Pokémon in your discard pile.

cards.flavorText: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

cards.name: Leafeon

attacks.name: Miasma Wind
attacks.text: Does 50 damage damage times the number of Special Conditions affecting the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Soothing Scent
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

cards.name: Metagross

attacks.name: Quad Smash
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

cards.name: Mismagius

attacks.name: Sleeping Spell
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Poltergeist
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand. This attack does 30 damage times the number of Trainer, Supporter, and Stadium cards in your opponent's hand.]

cards.flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

cards.name: Rotom

abilities.name: Mischievous Trick
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may switch 1 of your face-down Prize cards with the top card of your deck. This power can't be used if Rotom is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Plasma Arrow
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage for each Energy attached to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

cards.name: Skarmory

attacks.name: Steel Coat
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Metal Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

cards.name: Tropius

attacks.name: Fresh-Picked Fruit
attacks.text: Remove 6 damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

cards.name: Vespiquen

abilities.name: Defense Sign
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to your Benched Grass Pokémon by attacks.

attacks.name: Mach Wind
attacks.text: During your next turn, Vespiquen's Retreat Cost is 0.

cards.flavorText: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control Combee.

cards.name: Vileplume

abilities.name: Allergy Flower
abilities.text: Each player can't play any Trainer cards from his or her hand.

attacks.name: Dazzling Pollen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

cards.name: Weavile

abilities.name: Claw Snag
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Weavile from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may look at your opponent's hand. Choose a card from your opponent's hand and discard it.

attacks.name: Feint Attack
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on that Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

cards.name: Flareon

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to Flareon.

cards.flavorText: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Gloom

attacks.name: Miracle Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Special Condition. The Defending Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

cards.name: Jolteon

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Jolteon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

cards.name: Lairon

attacks.name: Scrap Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for a Metal Energy card and attach it to Lairon.

cards.flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

cards.name: Metang

attacks.name: Double Smash
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

cards.name: Muk

attacks.name: Sludge Drag
attacks.text: Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Pester
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its body is made of a powerful poison. Touching it accidentally will cause a fever that requires bed rest.

cards.name: Pinsir

attacks.name: Charging Horn
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: With its horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.

cards.name: Raichu

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

cards.name: Raticate

attacks.name: Razor-Sharp Incisors
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gnaw Up
attacks.text: Discard a Special Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its whiskers help it to maintain balance. Its fangs never stop growing, so it gnaws to pare them down.

cards.name: Sableye

attacks.name: Pull Out
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for any 1 card, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck.

attacks.name: Dark Hand
attacks.text: If you have more cards in your hand than your opponent, this attack does 20 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

cards.name: Scyther

attacks.name: Afterimage Strike
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if Scyther would be damaged by an attack, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that attack's damage done to Scyther.

cards.flavorText: When it moves, it leaves only a blur. If it hides in grass, its protective colors make it invisible.

cards.name: Skuntank

attacks.name: Stun Gas
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

cards.name: Slowbro

attacks.name: Full-Belly Refresh
attacks.text: Remove all Special Conditions and 3 damage counters from Slowbro.

attacks.name: Startling Trip
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, Slowbro is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Naturally dull to begin with, it lost its ability to feel pain due to Shellder's seeping poison.

cards.name: Togetic

attacks.name: Chase Up
attacks.text: Search your deck for any 1 card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage done to Togetic during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

cards.name: Unown

abilities.name: DARK
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Unown from your hand onto your Bench, you may search your deck for a Darkness Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Vaporeon

attacks.name: Spiral Drain
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from Vaporeon.

attacks.name: Dual Splash
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

cards.name: Aron

attacks.name: Metal Sound
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

cards.name: Beldum

attacks.name: Single Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground's natural magnetism, letting it float.

cards.name: Combee

attacks.name: Enraged Assault
attacks.text: If Vespiquen is on your Bench and has any damage counters on it, this attack does 20 damage plus 60 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a thousand, packed closely together in a lump.

cards.name: Doduo

attacks.name: Double Headstrike
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: By alternately raising and lowering its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.

cards.name: Drifloon

attacks.name: Minimize
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Drifloon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Pull
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Tickle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Its irregularly configured DNA is affected by its surroundings. It evolves if its environment changes.

cards.name: Gligar

attacks.name: Stun Poison
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

cards.name: Grimer

attacks.name: Sticky Liquid
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's Retreat Cost is Colorless more.

cards.flavorText: Wherever Grimer has passed, so many germs are left behind that no plants will ever grow again.

cards.name: Hitmonchan

attacks.name: Detect
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attack, including damage, done to Hitmonchan during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Sky Uppercut
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.flavorText: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavorText: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

cards.name: Houndour

attacks.name: Jump On
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

cards.name: Aggron

attacks.name: Second Strike
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 40 damage plus 40 more damage.

attacks.name: Guard Claw
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Aggron by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: You can tell its age by the length of its iron horns. It claims an entire mountain as its territory.

cards.name: Altaria

attacks.name: Midnight Eyes
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Stadium Power
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.

cards.name: Celebi

attacks.name: Future Sight
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of either player's deck and put them back on top of that player's deck in any order.

attacks.name: Leaf Bind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

cards.name: Drapion

attacks.name: Toxic Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

cards.flavorText: It attacks people and Pokémon that cross the desert. This has only furthered its bad reputation.

cards.name: Mamoswine

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Snowstorm
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

cards.name: Nidoking

abilities.name: Pheromone Stamina
abilities.text: Nidoking gets +20 HP for each Nidoqueen you have in play.

attacks.name: Venomous Horn
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Its tail is thick and powerful. If it binds an enemy, it can render the victim helpless quite easily.

cards.name: Porygon-Z

abilities.name: Dimension Transfer
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck. This power can't be used if Porygon-Z is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Suspicious Beam β
attacks.text: If Porygon-Z has no Rainbow Energy attached to it, Porygon-Z does 20 damage to itself and Porygon-Z is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error…

cards.name: Rapidash

abilities.name: Fiery Spirit
abilities.text: Rapidash can't be Confused.

attacks.name: Ring of Fire
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned and can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredibly fast.

cards.name: Solrock

abilities.name: Heal Block
abilities.text: If you have Lunatone in play, damage counters can't be removed from any Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's). (Damage counters can still be moved.)

attacks.name: Sun Flash
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

cards.name: Spiritomb

abilities.name: Spooky Whirlpool
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Spiritomb from your hand onto your Bench, you may use this power. Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws 6 cards.

attacks.name: Color Tag
attacks.text: Choose Grass Fire Water Lightning Psychic Fighting Darkness Metal or Colorless type. Put 1 damage counter on each Pokémon your opponent has in play of the type you chose.

cards.flavorText: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

cards.name: Venomoth

abilities.name: Poison Moth Wind
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. If tails, your Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. This power can't be used if Venomoth is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: The powder on its wings is poisonous if it is dark in hue. If it is light in hue, it causes paralysis.

cards.name: Victreebel

abilities.name: Tangling Tendrils
abilities.text: As long as Victreebel is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is ColorlessColorless more.

attacks.name: Acidic Drain
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned and Poisoned. Remove 3 damage counters from Victreebel.

cards.flavorText: Acid that has dissolved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.

cards.name: Ambipom

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose 2 cards from your opponent's hand without looking. Look at the cards you chose, then have your opponent shuffle those cards into his or her deck.

attacks.name: Tail Spank
attacks.text: Discard 2 cards from your hand. (If you can't discard 2 cards from your hand, this attack does nothing.)

cards.flavorText: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

cards.name: Banette

attacks.name: Lost Crush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and put it in the Lost Zone.

attacks.name: Breakdown
attacks.text: Count the number of cards in your opponent's hand. Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

cards.name: Bronzong

attacks.name: Legend Ceremony
attacks.text: Search your deck for both halves of a Pokémon LEGEND, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Reflect Energy
attacks.text: Move an Energy card attached to Bronzong to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

cards.name: Carnivine

attacks.name: Saliva Lure
attacks.text: Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Stick and Absorb
attacks.text: Remove 3 damage counters from Carnivine. The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

cards.name: Ditto

abilities.name: Dittobolic
abilities.text: The number of Benched Pokémon your opponent can have is now 4. If your opponent has 5 Benched Pokémon, your opponent must discard 1 of them and all cards attached to it.

cards.flavorText: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

cards.name: Dragonite

attacks.name: Calming Wind
attacks.text: Remove all Special Conditions from Dragonite.

attacks.name: Dragon Stamp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this attack does nothing. If both of them are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: This marine Pokémon has an impressive build that lets it freely fly over raging seas without trouble.

cards.name: Dugtrio

attacks.name: Sand Impact
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Fighting Energy attached to Dugtrio. This attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Extremely powerful, they can dig through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.

cards.name: Electivire

attacks.name: Plasma
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to Electivire.

attacks.name: Thunder Shot
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any Energy cards attached to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

cards.name: Elekid

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Elekid is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Elekid by attacks.

attacks.name: Sparking Ball
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. Elekid is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Even in the most vicious storm, this Pokémon plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

cards.name: Golduck

abilities.name: Natural Remedy
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Water Energy card from your hand to Golduck, remove 2 damage counters from Golduck.

attacks.name: Powerful Splash
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

cards.name: Grumpig

attacks.name: Psychic Lock
attacks.text: Your opponent can't use any Poké-Powers on his or her Pokémon during his or her next turn.

attacks.name: Bench Manipulation
attacks.text: Your opponent flips a coin for each of his or her Benched Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage times the number of tails. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

cards.name: Kricketune

attacks.name: Entrancing Melody
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Fury Cutter
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 40 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 100 more damage.

cards.flavorText: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.

cards.name: Lunatone

attacks.name: Selfdestruct
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Lunatone does 60 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

cards.name: Machamp

attacks.name: Vital Throw
attacks.text: You may do 40 damage plus 20 more damage. If you do, Machamp does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Hundred Furious Punches
attacks.text: Does 60 damage plus 10 more damage for each Fighting Energy attached to Machamp.

cards.flavorText: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

cards.name: Magmortar

attacks.name: Top Burner
attacks.text: For each Fire Energy attached to Magmortar, discard the top card from your opponent's deck. Then, flip a coin. If tail, discard all Fire Energy attached to Magmortar.

attacks.name: Burst Punch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

cards.name: Nidoqueen

attacks.name: Return
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Prize Count
attacks.text: If you have more Prize cards left than your opponent, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

cards.name: Pidgeot

attacks.name: Headwind
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the attack cost of each of the Defending Pokémon's attacks is ColorlessColorless more.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It spreads its beautiful wings wide to frighten its enemies. It can fly at Mach 2 speed.

cards.name: Sharpedo

attacks.name: Strip Bare
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, your opponent discards all card from his or her hand.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: Does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Sharpedo.

cards.flavorText: It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by jetting seawater through its body. It is the bandit of the sea.

cards.name: Wailord

attacks.name: Underwater Dive
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, remove 3 damage counters from Wailord.

attacks.name: Swallow Up
attacks.text: Before doing damage, count the remaining HP of the Defending Pokémon and Wailord. If the Defending Pokémon has fewer remaining HP than Wailord, this attack does 50 damage plus 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It is the largest of all identified Pokémon. They jump as a pack to herd their prey.

cards.name: Dragonair

attacks.name: Search and Invite
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.

cards.name: Electabuzz

attacks.name: Shock Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Lightning Energy attached to Electabuzz.

cards.flavorText: Its body constantly discharges electricity. Getting close to it will make your hair stand on end.

cards.name: Electrode

attacks.name: Lightning Strike
attacks.text: You may do 40 damage plus 60 more damage. If you do, discard all Lightning Energy attached to Electrode.

cards.flavorText: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.

cards.name: Haunter

attacks.name: Sneaky Placement
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sleep Poison
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.

cards.name: Kangaskhan

attacks.name: Split Spiral Punch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Dizzy Punch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.

cards.name: Lairon

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Lairon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

cards.name: Lickilicky

attacks.name: Licking Shot
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon for each Energy attached to Lickilicky. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Stick and Absorb
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from Lickilicky. The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It has space in its throat to store saliva. It can also roll up its tongue and store it in the same spot.

cards.name: Luvdisc

attacks.name: Rendezvous Draw
attacks.text: Each player draws and reveals the top card of his or her deck.

attacks.name: Distorted Wave
attacks.text: Before doing damage, remove 1 damage counter from the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a Luvdisc to someone you love.

cards.name: Machoke

attacks.name: Knuckle Down
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It always goes at its full power, but this very tough and durable Pokémon never gets tired.

cards.name: Magby

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Magby is Asleep, prevents all damage done to Magby by attacks.

attacks.name: Play with Fire
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned. Magby is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.

cards.name: Magmar

attacks.name: Eruption
attacks.text: Each player discards the top card of his or her deck. This attack does 20 damage times the number of Energy cards discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: The fiery surface of its body gives off a wavering, rippling glare that is similar to the sun.

cards.name: Magneton

attacks.name: Tri Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: The Magnemite are united by a magnetism so powerful, it dries all moisture in its vicinity.

cards.name: Marowak

attacks.name: Bonemerang
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 60 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Bone Impact
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 20 damage plus 60 more damage. Discard that Stadium card.

cards.flavorText: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out messages to others.

cards.name: Nidorina

attacks.name: Quick Blow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It has a calm and caring nature. Because its horn grows slowly, it prefers not to fight.

cards.name: Nidorino

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Quick to anger, it stabs enemies with its horn to inject a powerful poison when it becomes agitated.

cards.name: Pidgeotto

attacks.name: Twister
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this attack does nothing. For each heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It renders its prey immobile using well-developed claws, then carries the prey more than 60 miles to its nest.

cards.name: Piloswine

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

cards.name: Porygon2

abilities.name: Mapping
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Porygon2 from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may search your deck for a Stadium card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: 3-D Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

cards.name: Tentacruel

attacks.name: Tentavolve
attacks.text: If Tentacruel evolved from Tentacool during this turn, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its opponent inside a poisonous net.

cards.name: Unown

abilities.name: CURE
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Unown from your hand onto your Bench, remove all Special Conditions from your Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

cards.name: Wailmer

attacks.name: Double Attack
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It bounces playfully like a ball. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.

cards.name: Weepinbell

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Corrode Target
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and discard it.

cards.flavorText: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.

cards.name: Ho-Oh

attacks.name: Sacred Fire
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

cards.flavorText: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind when it flies.

cards.name: Lugia

attacks.name: Aeroblast
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Recharge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to Pikachu. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy attached to Pikachu.

cards.flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

cards.name: Wobbuffet

abilities.name: Tenacious Bind
abilities.text: As long as Wobbuffet is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is ColorlessColorless more.

attacks.name: Trip Over
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

cards.name: Hoothoot

abilities.name: Insomnia
abilities.text: Hoothoot can't be Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

cards.name: Noctowl

abilities.name: Night Scope
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at your opponent's hand. This power can't be used if Noctowl is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

abilities.name: Rain Dance
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Water Energy from your hand to 1 of your Water Pokémon. This power can't be used if Feraligatr is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hydro Crunch
attacks.text: Does 60 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

abilities.name: Leaf Trans
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Grass Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Meganium is affected by a Special Condition.

abilities.name: Afterburner
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your discard pile for a Fire Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. If you do, put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Typhlosion is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Flare Destroy
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card attached to Typhlosion and discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.name: Latias

attacks.name: Energy Assist
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Infinite Wind
attacks.text: If Latios is on your Bench, remove 2 damage counters from each of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

cards.name: Latios

abilities.name: Luster Float
abilities.text: If you have Latias in play, the Retreat Cost for Latios is 0.

attacks.name: Infinite Wing
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy attached to Latios.

cards.flavorText: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

cards.name: Cleffa

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Cleffa is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Cleffa by attacks.

attacks.name: Eeeeeeek
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 6 cards. Cleffa is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Smoochum

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Smoochum is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Smoochum by attacks.

attacks.name: Energy Antics
attacks.text: Move an Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon. Smoochum is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

cards.name: Lapras

attacks.name: Ferry
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a Supporter card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.

cards.flavorText: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

cards.name: Shuckle

abilities.name: Fermenting Liquid
abilities.text: Whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to Shuckle, draw a card.

attacks.name: Shell Stunner
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Shuckle by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

cards.name: Plusle

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Plusle does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

cards.name: Minun

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Tag Team Boost
attacks.text: If Plusle is on your Bench, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

cards.name: Tropical Tidal Wave
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, discard all Trainer and Stadium cards your opponent has in play. If tails, discard all Trainer and Stadium cards you have in play.

cards.name: Raikou

attacks.name: Zap Cannon
attacks.text: During your next turn, Raikou can't use Zap Cannon.

cards.flavorText: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

cards.name: Entei

attacks.name: Flare Blitz
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy attached to Entei.

cards.flavorText: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to contain its sheer power, it races headlong around the land.

cards.name: Suicune

attacks.name: Sheer Cold
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

cards.name: Porygon

attacks.name: Stiffen
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Porygon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Version Update
attacks.text: Search your deck for Porygon2, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It is a manmade Pokémon. Since it doesn't breathe, people are eager to try it in any environment..

cards.name: Porygon2

abilities.name: Shortcut
abilities.text: The Retreat Cost for each Porygon, Porygon2, and Porygon-Z you have in play is Colorless less.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: Porygon2 does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: This upgraded version of Porygon is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.

cards.name: Hitmonchan

attacks.name: Detect
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Hitmonchan during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Sky Uppercut
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.flavorText: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

cards.name: Snivy

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

cards.name: Maractus

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pin Missile
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

cards.name: Tepig

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

cards.name: Oshawott

attacks.name: Water Pulse
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

cards.name: Alomomola
cards.flavorText: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

cards.name: Blitzle

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

cards.name: Munna

attacks.name: Yawn
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

cards.name: Sandile

attacks.name: Sand Tomb
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

cards.name: Zorua

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

cards.name: Klink

attacks.name: Charge Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, attach an Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

cards.name: Pidove

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

cards.name: Audino

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

cards.name: Servine

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

cards.name: Pansage

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

cards.name: Dwebble

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: The Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

cards.name: Pignite

attacks.name: Flame Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

cards.name: Dewott

attacks.name: Razor Shell
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

cards.name: Emolga

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Acrobatics
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membranes and released while it is gliding.

cards.name: Woobat

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

cards.name: Drilbur

attacks.name: Hone ClawsScratch
attacks.text: During your next turn, each of this Pokémon's attacks does 30 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

cards.name: Purrloin

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

cards.name: Klang

attacks.name: Metal Sound
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

cards.name: Axew

attacks.name: Dual Chop
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

cards.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

cards.name: Torchic

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Epic Splash
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

cards.name: Totodile

attacks.name: Fury Strikes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Tail Whip
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

cards.name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Heartfelt Song
attacks.text: Discard a Darkness Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

cards.name: Togepi

attacks.name: Sweet Kiss
attacks.text: Your opponent draws a card.

cards.flavorText: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

cards.name: Dedenne

attacks.name: Nuzzle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Spiral Drain
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

cards.name: Meowth

attacks.name: Act Tough
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Darkness Energy attached to it, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Caterpie

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor

attacks.name: Tropical Shake
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each type of basic Energy card in your discard pile. You can't add more than 100 damage in this way.

cards.flavorText: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

cards.name: Magmar

attacks.name: Controlled Burn
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When angered, it spouts brilliant fire from all over its body. It doesn't calm down until its opponent has burned to ash.

cards.name: Alolan Sandshrew

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: An ancient tradition of Alolan festivals, still carried on to this day, is a competition to slide Sandshrew across ice as far as one can.

cards.name: Lapras

attacks.name: Aqua Bullet
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage times the amount of Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: These Pokémon were once near extinction due to poaching. Following protective regulations, there is now an overabundance of them.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Iron Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Gastly

attacks.name: Ominous Eyes
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Should a strange light be seen flickering in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.

cards.name: Mankey

attacks.name: Three-Step Strike
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages, and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.

cards.name: Onix

attacks.name: Screech
attacks.text: During your next turn, the Defending Pokémon takes 20 more damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth

attacks.name: Spoil the Fun
attacks.text: If you go second, this attack does 60 more damage during your first turn.

cards.flavorText: When its delicate pride is wounded, or when the gold coin on its forehead is dirtied, it flies into a hysterical rage.

cards.name: Alolan Dugtrio

attacks.name: Gold Rush
attacks.text: Discard any number of Metal Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 30 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon are cherished in the Alola region, where they are thought to be feminine deities of the land incarnate.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Ampharos

attacks.name: Gigaspark
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

cards.name: Azumarill

attacks.name: Bubble Shower
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.

cards.name: Bellossom

attacks.name: Sweet Nectar
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flower Dance
attacks.text: Does 30 damage times the number of cards with Bellossom in their names that you have in play (including this one).

cards.flavorText: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

cards.name: Feraligatr

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.text: When you play Feraligatr from your hand, flip a coin. If heads, discard the top 5 cards from your opponent's deck. If tails, discard the top 5 cards from your deck.

attacks.name: Chomp
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of damage counters on Feraligatr. This attack does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

cards.name: Feraligatr

abilities.name: Downpour
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Water Energy card from your hand. This power can't be used if Feraligatr is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Riptide
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 damage times the number of Water Energy cards in your discard pile. Then, shuffle all Water Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

cards.flavorText: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.

cards.name: Heracross

abilities.name: Final Blow
abilities.text: If Heracross's remaining HP are 20 or less, you may make its Megahorn attack's base damage 120 instead of 60. This power can't be used if Heracross is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Megahorn
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

cards.name: Jumpluff

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: If this attack damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), remove 1 damage counter from Jumpluff, if it has any.

cards.flavorText: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.

cards.name: Kingdra

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Kingdra.

attacks.name: Dragon Tornado
attacks.text: If this attack doesn't Knock Out the Defending Pokémon, and if there are any Pokémon on your opponent's Bench, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

cards.name: Lugia

attacks.name: Elemental Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy card, a Water Energy card, and a Lightning Energy card attached to Lugia in order to use this attack.

cards.flavorText: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea, because its powers are too strong.

cards.name: Meganium

abilities.name: Herbal Scent
abilities.text: When you play Meganium from your hand, you may flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from all Grass Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

cards.name: Meganium

abilities.name: Wild Growth
abilities.text: As long as Meganium is in play each Grass Energy card attached to your Grass Pokémon instead provides GrassGrass. This power stops working while Meganium is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Soothing Scent
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

cards.name: Pichu
rules: If this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin (before doing anything required in order to use that attack). If tails, your opponent's turn ends without an attack.

attacks.name: Zzzap
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to each Pokémon in play that has a Pokémon Power. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

cards.name: Skarmory

attacks.name: Claw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Steel Wing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, all damage done by attacks to Skarmory during your opponent's next turn is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.

cards.name: Slowking

abilities.name: Mind Games
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent plays a Trainer card, you may flip a coin. If heads, that card does nothing. Put it on top of your opponent's deck. This power can't be used if Slowking is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Mind Blast
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.flavorText: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

cards.name: Steelix

attacks.name: Tail Crush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage.

cards.flavorText: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

cards.name: Togetic

attacks.name: Super Metronome
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose an attack on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Super Metronome copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else in order to use that attack.) (No matter what type the Defending Pokémon is, Togetic's type is still Colorless.) Togetic performs that attack. (Togetic can make that attack even if it does not have the appropriate number or type of Energy attached to it necessary to make the attack.)

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Togetic; if tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

cards.flavorText: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

cards.name: Typhlosion

abilities.name: Fire Recharge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, attach a Fire Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Fire Pokémon. This power can't be used if Typhlosion is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Flame Burst
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage and does 20 damage to Typhlosion. If tails, this attack does 60 damage.

cards.flavorText: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

cards.name: Typhlosion

abilities.name: Fire Boost
abilities.text: When you play Typhlosion from your hand, you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for up to 4 Fire Energy cards and attach them to Typhlosion. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Flame Wheel
attacks.text: Discard 3 Fire Energy cards attached to Typhlosion in order to use this attack. Do 20 damage to each Benched Pokémon (yours and your opponent's). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

cards.name: Metal Energy
rules:
Damage done to the Pokémon Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). If the Pokémon Metal Energy is attached to isn't Metal, whenever it damages a Pokémon, reduce that damage by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
Metal Energy provides Metal Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

cards.name: Cleffa
rules: If this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin (before doing anything required in order to use that attack). If tails, your opponent's turn ends without an attack.

attacks.name: Eeeeeeek
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 7 cards.

cards.flavorText: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Donphan

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Donphan.

attacks.name: Rapid Spin
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with his or her Active Pokémon, then, if you have any Benched Pokémon, you switch 1 of them with your Active Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

cards.name: Elekid
rules: If this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin (before doing anything required in order to use that attack). If tails, your opponent's turn ends without an attack.

abilities.name: Playful Punch
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, do 20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon. (Apply Weakness and Resistance.) Either way, this ends your turn. This power can't be used if Elekid is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.

cards.name: Magby
