attacks.name: Thrash Tackle
attacks.text: Gyarados does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Volt Tackle
attacks.text: Pikachu does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Skuntank.

cards.name: Mew

attacks.name: Rainbow Wave
attacks.text: Choose a type of Energy other than Colorless attached to Mew. This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon of that type (including Benched Pokémon). Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's body is covered by fine hairs that can be seen only under a microscope.

cards.name: Pidgeot

attacks.name: Supersonic Flight
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon searches for food while flying at Mach 2. Its large claws make fearsome weapons.

cards.name: Onix

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon burrows through the earth at high speed, looking for food. The tunnels it digs are used by Diglett as nests.

cards.name: Togepi

attacks.name: Bawl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is still immature. When threatened, it releases poison from its head and tries to drive its enemies away.

cards.name: Ivysaur

attacks.name: Strange Scent
attacks.text: Each player flips a coin. Each player who gets heads chooses a total of 3 damage counters from among his or her Pokémon and removes them. (If the player's Pokémon have fewer total damage counters than that, he or she removes all of them.)

cards.flavorText: A sure sign spring is on its way is when the seed on this Pokémon's back flowers.

cards.name: Raticate

attacks.name: Sharp Teeth
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon sometimes hunts for food in rivers, swimming using the small webs between the toes on its rear legs.

cards.name: Ledyba

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Ledyba.

cards.flavorText: When it senses enemies approaching, this Pokémon releases an orange fluid from the joints in its legs and flees.

cards.name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Tempting Eyes
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: After lulling its enemies with its large eyes, this Pokémon sings them to sleep with a relaxing melody.

cards.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Butterfree. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

attacks.name: Rainbow Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: The poison scales on its wings are waterproof, allowing this Pokémon to be active even on rainy days.

cards.name: Tentacruel

attacks.name: Tentacle Grip
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Water Energy attached to Tentacruel. For each heads, draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon attacks its prey with its eighty toxin-producing tentacles.

cards.name: Marill

attacks.name: Squirt
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's fur repels water like a duck's feathers, allowing it to stay dry and fluffy even in water.

cards.name: Lapras

attacks.name: Gentle Song
attacks.text: If Lapras has any damage counters on it, remove 2 of them from it (1 if it only has 1). If the Defending Pokémon has any damage counters on it, remove 2 of them from it (1 if it only has 1). The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: This gentle Pokémon can understand human language and allows people to ride on its back.

cards.name: Exeggutor

attacks.name: Sharpshooter
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Grass Energy attached to Exeggutor. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has a unique cry, as all three of its heads are always talking independently of one another.

cards.name: Slowking

attacks.name: Revelation
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its nonchalant reaction to everything somehow gives this Pokémon an imposing presence.

cards.name: Wartortle

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Wartortle but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

cards.flavorText: When attacked, this Pokémon withdraws into its shell, although it can't quite pull in all of its long tail.

cards.name: Lickitung

attacks.name: Lick Wounds
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) with damage counters on it and remove 2 damage counters from it (1 if it only has 1).

attacks.name: Tongue Stretch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon uses its six-foot tongue as if it were a hand. The origin of its anaesthetic properties is still a mystery.

cards.name: Vileplume

attacks.name: Paradise Pollen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove 2 damage counters from Vileplume (1 if it only has 1). Then, if you have any Benched Pokémon with damage counters on them, choose 1 of them and remove 2 damage counters from it (1 if it only has 1).

attacks.name: Horrid Pollen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon makes a loud jangling noise when it shakes its petals to spread poison powder.

cards.name: Primeape

attacks.name: Rampage
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Primeape. Flip a coin. If tails, Primeape is now Confused (after doing damage).

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon only calms down when there are no other animals or people around—which means no one has ever seen it when it's not angry.

cards.name: Caterpie

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

cards.name: Metapod

attacks.name: Iron Defense
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

cards.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: No matter how much it eats, the mushrooms growing on its back steal away most of the nutrients it consumes.

cards.name: Parasect

attacks.name: Fury Cutter
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 60 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 120 damage.

attacks.name: Mushroom Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The large mushroom on its back controls it. It often fights over territory with Shiinotic.

cards.name: Pinsir

attacks.name: Roof Fling
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put your opponent's Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.

cards.name: Surskit

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: When this Pokémon senses danger, a sweet fluid oozes from the tip of its heads. The taste of it disgusts bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Masquerain

attacks.name: Struggle Bug
attacks.text: Move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its wings and antennae don't cope well with moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to dry off.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

cards.name: Dartrix

attacks.name: Sharp Blade Quill
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Leaf Blade
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

cards.name: Decidueye

attacks.name: Leaf Blade
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Brave Bird
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

cards.name: Decidueye-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Feather Arrow
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hollow Hunt-GX
attacks.text: Put 3 cards from your discard pile into your hand. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.flavorText: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Fomantis

attacks.name: Synthesis
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.

cards.name: Lurantis-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Flower Supply
attacks.text: Attach 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Solar Blade
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Chloroscythe-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage times the amount of Grass Energy attached to this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Morelull

attacks.name: Flickering Spores
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

cards.name: Shiinotic

abilities.name: Illuminate
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Grass Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Flickering Spores
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

cards.name: Bounsweet

attacks.name: Sweet Scent
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

cards.name: Steenee

attacks.name: Sweet Scent
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

cards.name: Tsareena

abilities.name: Queenly Majesty
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may have your opponent reveal their hand. Then, discard a card from it.

attacks.name: Trop Kick
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage and remove all Special Conditions from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

cards.name: Growlithe

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It's both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.

cards.name: Arcanine

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Firestorm
attacks.text: Discard 3 Fire Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Overflowing with beauty and majesty, this strong Pokémon appears in ancient Eastern folklore.

cards.name: Torkoal

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mounts where they live.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

cards.name: Torracat

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

cards.name: Incineroar

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Darkest Lariat
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

cards.name: Incineroar-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Hustling Strike
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your Benched Fire Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tiger Swing
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Burning Slam-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Confusion Wave
attacks.text: Both Active Pokémon are now Confused.

cards.flavorText: As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without meaning to.

cards.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Double Jet
attacks.text: Discard up to 2 Water Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: It is said that the red part of its forehead grants supernatural powers to those who posses one, so it was over-hunted in the past.

cards.name: Poliwag

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage times the amount of Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It's still not very good at walking. Its Trainers should train this Pokémon to walk every day.

cards.name: Poliwhirl

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It marches over the land in search of bug Pokémon to eat. Then it takes them underwater so it can dine on them where it's safe.

cards.name: Poliwrath

attacks.name: Split Spiral Punch
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Wake-Up Slap
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 80 more damage. Then, remove all Special Conditions from that Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its percentage of body fat is nearly zero. Its body is entirely muscle, which makes it heavy and forces its swimming prowess to develop.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.flavorText: The hardness of its shell surpasses the hardness of a diamond. In days gone by, people used the shells to make shields.

cards.name: Cloyster

attacks.name: Headlock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Its hard shell cannot be shattered—not even by a bomb. The contents of the shell remain unknown.

cards.name: Lapras-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Blizzard Burn
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Ice Beam-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Corsola

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes.

cards.name: Wingull

attacks.name: Roost
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. It can't retreat during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: Fishermen keep an eye out for Wingull in the sky, because wherever they're circling, the ocean sure to be is teeming with fish Pokémon.

cards.name: Pelipper

attacks.name: Courier
attacks.text: Put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your hand.

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

cards.name: Popplio
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

cards.name: Brionne

attacks.name: Disarming Voice
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards it enemies.

cards.name: Primarina

attacks.name: Disarming Voice
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Sparkling Aria
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learning from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

cards.name: Primarina-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Bubble Beat
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Water Energy attached to your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Roaring Seas
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Grand Echo-GX
attacks.text: Heal all damage from all of your Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Crabominable

attacks.name: Avalanche
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.

cards.name: Wishiwashi

abilities.name: Cowardice
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard all cards attached to this Pokémon and return it to your hand. You can't use this Ability during your first turn or on the turn this Pokémon was put into play.

cards.flavorText: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

cards.name: Dewpider

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

cards.name: Araquanid

abilities.name: Water Bubble
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Fire Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

cards.name: Pyukumuku

abilities.name: Innards Out
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, put 6 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Continuous Tumble
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.

cards.name: Bruxish

attacks.name: Vivid Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Psychic Fangs
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

cards.name: Chinchou

attacks.name: Searching Light
attacks.text: Look at 1 of your face-down Prize cards.

cards.flavorText: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Lanturn

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Aqua Spark
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Water Energy attached to it, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

cards.name: Charjabug

attacks.name: Shocking Jaws
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac.

cards.name: Pheromosa & Buzzwole-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Jet Punch
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Elegant Sole
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Elegant Sole attack's base damage is 60.

attacks.name: Beast Game-GX
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 1 more Prize card. If this Pokémon has at least 7 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), take 3 more Prize cards instead. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Caterpie

abilities.name: Pupate
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly, it has a voracious appetite, eating a hundred leaves a day.

cards.name: Metapod

abilities.name: Emerge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is filled with a thick liquid. All of the cells throughout its body are being rebuilt in preparation for evolution.

cards.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Triple Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Its wings are covered in toxic scales. If it finds bird Pokémon going after Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles its scales on them to drive them off.

cards.name: Oddish

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: During the day, It stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: During the day, It stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Gloom

abilities.name: Irresistible Aroma
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if your opponent's Bench isn't full, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent reveals their hand. Put a Basic Pokémon you find there onto their Bench.

cards.flavorText: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

cards.name: Vileplume

abilities.name: Varied Pollen
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, choose Asleep, Burned, Confused, or Poisoned. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.

attacks.name: Giant Bloom
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

cards.name: Venonat

attacks.name: Radar Eyes
attacks.text: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

cards.flavorText: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

cards.name: Venonat

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

cards.name: Venomoth

attacks.name: Assassin Flight
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition. This attack does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Poison Powder
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.

cards.name: Venomoth-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Shinobi Mastery
attacks.text: If you played Koga's Trap from your hand during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage. If you played Janine from your hand during this turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Ten-Card Return-GX
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 10 cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.flavorText: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

cards.name: Weepinbell

attacks.name: Burning Venom
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned and Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage times the amount of Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

cards.name: Gyarados-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam-GX
attacks.text: (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

cards.name: Vaporeon

attacks.name: Bubble Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Clean, clear waters are its usual habitat. When it's about to be attacked by an invading enemy, it dives into the water to hide.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Raichu-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Spark Ball-GX
attacks.text: (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

cards.name: Electrode

attacks.name: Electroblast
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

cards.name: Jolteon

abilities.name: Electromagnetic Wall
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.

cards.name: Zapdos

attacks.name: Hurricane Call
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. For each heads, search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

cards.name: Ekans

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.flavorText: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

cards.name: Arbok

abilities.name: Last Pattern
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, discard 2 random cards from your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Rocket Tail
attacks.text: If Jessie & James is in your discard pile, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

cards.name: Weezing

abilities.name: Surrender Now
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is discarded with the effect of Jessie & James, you may have your opponent discard a card from their hand. (They discard that card after the effect of Jessie & James.)

cards.flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

cards.name: Mewtwo-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Psycrush-GX
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.flavorText: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

cards.name: Graveler

attacks.name: Mudslide
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fighting Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

cards.name: Golem

attacks.name: Rock Slide
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 3 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

cards.name: Onix-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Rocky Avalanche-GX
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 100 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance). (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Cubone

attacks.name: Sharpshooting
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: The skull it wears on its head is that of its dead mother. According to some, it will evolve when it comes to terms with the pain of her death.

cards.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Lead
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: It can't help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren't many people or Pokémon.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

cards.name: Wigglytuff-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Rolling Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Lovely Star-GX
attacks.text: Heal all damage from this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Mr. Mime

attacks.name: Happy Mime
attacks.text: Each player draws a card.

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

cards.name: Moltres & Zapdos & Articuno-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Sky Legends-GX
attacks.text: Shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Fire, Water, and Lightning Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 110 damage to 3 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

cards.name: Chansey

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It seems that other Pokémon's efforts to take its delicious, nutritious egg away from it caused Chansey to get faster at fleeing.

cards.name: Kangaskhan

attacks.name: Parental Fury
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

cards.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Curiosity
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

attacks.name: Spin Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: It doesn't do anything other than eat and sleep. When prompted to make a serious effort, though, it apparently displays awesome power.

cards.name: Bill's Analysis
rules: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal up to 2 Trainer cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Blaine's Last Stand
rules: You can play this card only when it is the last card in your hand.
Draw 2 cards for each Fire Pokémon you have in play.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Brock's Grit
rules: Shuffle 6 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Brock's Pewter City Gym
rules: Onix-GX (both yours and your opponent's) take 40 less damage from the opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

cards.name: Brock's Training
rules: Attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Geodude, Graveler, Golem, Onix-GX, Cubone, Rhyhorn, Rhydon, or Sudowoodo.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Venusaur & Snivy-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Shining Vine
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, when you attach a Grass Energy card from your hand to it, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Solar Plant-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), heal all damage from all of your Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Oddish

attacks.name: Sweet Scent
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Gloom

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

cards.name: Vileplume-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Fragrant Flower Garden
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Massive Bloom
attacks.text: This attack does 10 less damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Allergic Explosion-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned, Paralyzed, and Poisoned. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Tangela

attacks.name: Toxic
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

cards.flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

cards.name: Tangrowth

attacks.name: Grass Knot
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

cards.name: Sunkern

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.

cards.name: Sunflora

attacks.name: Solar Power
attacks.text: During your next turn, ignore all Energy in the attack costs of Grass Pokémon and Fire Pokémon. (This includes Pokémon that come into play on that turn.)

cards.flavorText: As the hot season approaches, the petals on this Pokémon's face become more vivid and lively.

cards.name: Heracross

attacks.name: Riled Horn
attacks.text: If your opponent has any TAG TEAM Pokémon in play, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It's proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it's always fighting with.

cards.name: Lileep

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: In ancient times, it lived in warm seas. It disguised itself as seaweed to ambush its prey and devoured them whole when they got close.

cards.name: Cradily

abilities.name: Swaying Strangle
abilities.text: Your opponent's Pokémon that are affected by Special Conditions can't retreat.

attacks.name: Poison Tentacles
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Normally, it lived on shallow sea shoals. When the tide went out, this Pokémon came up on land to search for prey.

cards.name: Tropius

attacks.name: Synthesis
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Leaf Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The bunches of fruit growing around the necks of Tropius in Alola are especially sweet compared to those in other regions.

cards.name: Kricketot

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.

cards.name: Kricketune

attacks.name: Improvisational Performance
attacks.text: If you have exactly 1 card in your hand, this attack does 100 more damage. If you have exactly 3 cards in your hand, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. If you have exactly 6 cards in your hand, this attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

cards.name: Deerling
cards.flavorText: Their coloring changes according to the season and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.

cards.name: Sawsbuck

abilities.name: Seasonal Blessings
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw a card.

attacks.name: Bounce
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

cards.name: Rowlet

attacks.name: Hide and Seek
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

cards.name: Rowlet

attacks.name: Skill Dive
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

cards.name: Dartrix

attacks.name: Wing Flick
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don't groom it diligently, it will stop listening to you.

cards.name: Decidueye

attacks.name: Skill Dive
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Tracking Shot
attacks.text: This attack does 80 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents. When it simply can't afford to miss, it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.

cards.name: Buzzwole

abilities.name: Beast Boost
abilities.text: This Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon for each Prize card you have taken (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Touchdown
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

cards.name: Charizard & Braixen-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Brilliant Flare
attacks.text: You may search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Crimson Flame Pillar-GX
attacks.text: Attach 5 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned and Confused. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Ponyta

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

cards.name: Rapidash

attacks.name: Overrun
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

cards.name: Flareon

abilities.name: Power Cheer
abilities.text: The attacks of your Pokémon-GX in play that evolve from Eevee do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You can't apply more than 1 Power Cheer Ability at a time.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If it inhales deeply, that's a sign it's about to attack. Prepare to be hit by flames of over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit!

cards.name: Slugma

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

cards.name: Magcargo

attacks.name: Stomp Off
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

cards.name: Entei

attacks.name: Rally Back
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during their last turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

cards.name: Torkoal

attacks.name: Fire Fling
attacks.text: Put 4 Fire Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Kindle
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: You can tell how it's feeling by the smoke spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity is a sign of good health.

cards.name: Victini

abilities.name: Victory Heal
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may heal 20 damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.flavorText: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

cards.name: Emboar

abilities.name: Explosive Fire Dance
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may look at the top 8 cards of your deck and attach any number of basic Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

cards.flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.flavorText: When battling opponents, it sprays fire from its five horns. The max temperature of the flames can reach nearly 5,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Volcarona-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Flaming Shot
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Fire Energy card from your hand. If you do, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Backfire
attacks.text: Put 2 Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

attacks.name: Massive Heat Wave-GX
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from each of your opponent's Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Litleo
cards.flavorText: When they're young, they live with a pride. Once they're able to hunt prey on their own, they're kicked out and have to make their own way.

cards.name: Pyroar

attacks.name: Swirling Inferno
attacks.text: Discard all Pokémon Tool cards and Special Energy from each of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.

cards.name: Blastoise & Piplup-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Splash Maker
attacks.text: You may attach up to 3 Water Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like. If you do, heal 50 damage from those Pokémon for each card you attached to them in this way.

attacks.name: Bubble Launcher-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra Water Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 150 more damage. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix

abilities.name: Snowed In
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

cards.flavorText: If you carelessly approach it because it's cute, the boss of the pack, Ninetales, will appear and freeze you.

cards.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Confusion Wave
attacks.text: Both Active Pokémon are now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Energy Loop
attacks.text: Put an Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

cards.flavorText: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.

cards.name: Vaporeon

abilities.name: Vitality Cheer
abilities.text: Your Pokémon-GX in play that evolve from Eevee get +60 HP. You can't apply more than 1 Vitality Cheer Ability at a time.

attacks.name: Refreshing Rain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Clean, clear waters are its usual habitat. When it's about to be attacked by an invading enemy, it dives into the water to hide.

cards.name: Sneasel

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokémon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.

cards.name: Weavile

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: One Weavile will trip a Sandshrew and flip it over, and then another Weavile will deal the finishing blow with its sharp claws.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.flavorText: It swims along with its mouth open and swallows down seawater along with its food. It sprays excess water out of its nostrils.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.flavorText: They eat so many fish Pokémon that when Wailord become too numerous, fishermen have to chase them off.

cards.name: Snorunt

attacks.name: Continuous Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.

cards.name: Glalie

attacks.name: Ice Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed, and discard an Energy from that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Frosty Typhoon
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Frosty Typhoon during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: It freezes its prey and chews them whole. However, it prefers to eat Pokémon like Vanillite that are already frozen.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.flavorText: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

cards.name: Spheal

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

cards.name: Sealeo
cards.flavorText: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.

cards.name: Walrein

attacks.name: Cold Snap
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Trainer cards from their hand during their next turn. If 1 of your Pokémon used Cold Snap during your last turn, this attack can't be used.

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

cards.name: Kyogre

attacks.name: High Water
attacks.text: Attach 2 Water Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Swirling Waves
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

cards.name: Piplup

attacks.name: Bubble Hold
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It doesn't like to be taken care of. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.

cards.name: Prinplup

attacks.name: Direct Dive
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Bellsprout

cards.name: Weepinbell

cards.name: Petilil

cards.name: Victini

cards.flavorText: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

cards.name: Chandelure

attacks.name: Raging Thunder
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will be frozen stiff in an instant.

cards.name: Horsea

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

cards.name: Seadra

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

cards.name: Kingdra

attacks.name: Brine
attacks.text: This attack does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Tornado Shot
attacks.text: Discard a Water Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

cards.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Splashing Dodge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

cards.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Venting Anger
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Magikarp in your discard pile.

attacks.name: Splash Burn
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: A tale is told of a town that angered Gyarados. Before the sun rose the next day, flames utterly consumed the town, leaving not a trace behind.

cards.name: Marill

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.

cards.name: Azumarill

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from the attacks of your opponent's Fire or Water Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of living things on riverbeds.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

cards.name: Simipour

attacks.name: Aqua Reflect
attacks.text: Move a Water Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

cards.name: Bruxish

attacks.name: Gnash Teeth
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Synchronoise
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that shares a type with your opponent's Active Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

cards.name: Tapu Fini-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Aqua Ring
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hydro Shot
attacks.text: Discard 2 Water Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Tapu Storm-GX
attacks.text: Shuffle your opponent's Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it into their deck. If your opponent has no Benched Pokémon, this attack does nothing. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Tapu Fini-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Aqua Ring
