cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Raichu

abilities.name: Evoshock
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may leave your opponent's Active Pokémon Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Volt Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It unleashes electric shocks that can reach 100,000 volts. When agitated, it can knock out even an Indian elephant.

cards.name: Electabuzz

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Half of all sudden blackouts are caused by Electabuzz gathering at electric power plants and gobbling up electricity.

cards.name: Electivire

attacks.name: Thunder Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage. If tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes and then lets loose a high-voltage current. Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant.

cards.name: Tynamo

attacks.name: Aqua Shock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has any Water Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Eelektrik

attacks.name: Small Appetite
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon's maximum HP is 100 or more, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

cards.name: Eelektross

attacks.name: Dark Clamp
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Vacuum Bolt
attacks.text: You may do 80 more damage. If you do, this attack does 80 damage to 1 of your Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

cards.name: Togedemaru

attacks.name: Electrosmash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

cards.name: Slowking

attacks.name: Drift Ashore
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Unarmed
attacks.text: If you have no cards in your hand, ignore all Energy in this attack's cost.

cards.flavorText: A poisonous bite reacted with its system, blessing it with the enhanced intellect of a genius. It has full control of its psychic powers.

cards.name: Wobbuffet

attacks.name: Shadowy Knot
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

cards.flavorText: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

cards.name: Seviper

abilities.name: More Poison
abilities.text: Put 1 more damage counter on your opponent's Poisoned Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Venomous Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

cards.name: Ivysaur

attacks.name: Toxic Whip
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.

cards.name: Venusaur

abilities.name: Jungle Totem
abilities.text: Each basic Grass Energy attached to your Pokémon provides GrassGrass Energy. You can't apply more than 1 Jungle Totem Ability at a time.

cards.flavorText: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun's rays, it fills its body with power.

cards.name: Shroomish

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

cards.name: Breloom

attacks.name: Hibernation Spore
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. Your opponent flips 2 coins instead of 1 between turns. If either of them is tails, that Pokémon is still Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

cards.name: Carnivine

attacks.name: Flick Poison
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. The new Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

cards.name: Shaymin

attacks.name: Flippity Flap
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards.

attacks.name: Rally Back
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during their last turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

cards.name: Virizion

attacks.name: Wrapped in Wind
attacks.text: You may attach a basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pike
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

cards.name: Shining Genesect

abilities.name: Energy Reload
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Grass Energy from 1 of your other Pokémon to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gaia Blaster
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Grass Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

cards.name: Entei-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Brave Burn-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 150 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Entei-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Brave Burn-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 150 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Torkoal

attacks.name: High-Pressure Heat
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's High-Pressure Heat attack does 50 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.flavorText: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

cards.name: Volcarona

abilities.name: Heat Cyclone
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may have your opponent switch their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

cards.name: Reshiram

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Scorching Breath
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

cards.name: Torracat

attacks.name: Swagger
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

cards.name: Incineroar

attacks.name: Profane Punch
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 80 more damage.

attacks.name: Flare Blitz
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

cards.name: Croconaw

abilities.name: Plunge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may move all Energy from your Active Pokémon to this Pokémon. If you do, switch it with your Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

cards.name: Feraligatr

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

cards.name: Qwilfish

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Shocking Sting
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.flavorText: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

cards.name: Floatzel

attacks.name: Aqua Bomb
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

cards.name: Palkia

attacks.name: Spiral Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

cards.name: Manaphy

abilities.name: Blessings of the Deep
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may heal 20 damage from 1 of your Pokémon that has any Water Energy attached to it.

cards.flavorText: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Keldeo

attacks.name: Bail Out
attacks.text: Put a Water Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Resolute Blade
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

cards.name: Shining Volcanion

attacks.name: Dual Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Quad Smash
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Iron Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Raichu-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Powerful Spark
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Lightning Energy attached to your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Voltail-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

cards.name: Electrode

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

cards.name: Raikou

attacks.name: Booming Thunder
attacks.text: Attach a Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

cards.name: Plusle

attacks.name: Tag Team Boost
attacks.text: If Minun is on your Bench, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

cards.name: Minun

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

cards.name: Zekrom

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Storm Blade
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.

cards.name: Ekans

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

cards.name: Arbok

abilities.name: Intimidating Pattern
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Venomous Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

cards.name: Jynx

attacks.name: Whiny Voice
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

attacks.name: Feverish Kiss
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

cards.name: Mewtwo-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Full Burst
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage times the amount of Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Super Absorption
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psystrike-GX
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Shining Mew

attacks.name: Legendary Guidance
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

cards.name: Latios

attacks.name: Break Through
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

cards.name: Shining Jirachi

attacks.name: Stellar Reign
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an evolved Pokémon, devolve it by putting all of the Evolution cards on it into your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

cards.name: Golett
cards.flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

cards.name: Golurk

attacks.name: Triple Smash
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 60 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

cards.name: Marshadow

abilities.name: Let Loose
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may have each player shuffle their hand into their deck and draw 4 cards.

attacks.name: Shadow Punch
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

cards.name: Weedle

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Kakuna

attacks.name: Multiply
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Kakuna and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

cards.name: Beedrill

attacks.name: Sudden Sting
attacks.text: If this Pokémon evolved from Kakuna during this turn, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

cards.name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.

cards.name: Cacnea

attacks.name: Sucker Punch
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Darkness Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

cards.name: Cacturne

attacks.name: Spike Rend
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Hunt
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

cards.name: Karrablast

abilities.name: Shell On
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Shelmet from your hand. If you do, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

cards.name: Shelmet

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

cards.name: Accelgor

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon and heal all damage from it.

cards.flavorText: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

cards.name: Skiddo
cards.flavorText: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

cards.name: Gogoat

abilities.name: Sap Sipper
abilities.text: This Pokémon's attacks do 80 more damage to your opponent's Grass Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Horn Leech
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being.

cards.name: Alolan Marowak

attacks.name: Dance of Flames
attacks.text: For each Energy attached to your opponent's Pokémon, attach a Fire Energy card from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Burning Bonemerang
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage for each heads. If either of them is heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: The bones it possesses were once its mother's. Its mother's regrets have become like a vengeful spirit protecting this Pokémon.

cards.name: Numel

attacks.name: Continuous Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

cards.name: Camerupt

attacks.name: Continuous Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: Large numbers of these Pokémon make their home at the seaside. At night, a strange red glow radiates from the center of their bodies.

cards.name: Starmie

abilities.name: Escape
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck.

cards.flavorText: Its shining core is thought to receive and transmit enigmatic signals. It has been known to cause headaches in those who approach it.

cards.name: Magikarp

abilities.name: Submerge
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Waterfall Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

cards.name: Gyarados-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Draconic Disaster
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 100 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium card.

attacks.name: Dread Storm-GX
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from each of your opponent's Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Swinub
cards.flavorText: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

cards.name: Piloswine

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep. Heal 90 damage from it.

cards.flavorText: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.

cards.name: Mamoswine

attacks.name: Double Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Slashing Strike.

cards.flavorText: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.

cards.name: Rolycoly
cards.flavorText: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

cards.name: Grapploct V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Tie Up
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Moonsault Press
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 100 more damage.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.flavorText: The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food. It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg gets stuck, and Ekans faints.

cards.name: Arbok
cards.flavorText: After stunning its opponents with the pattern on its stomach, it quickly wraps them up in its body and waits for them to stop moving.

cards.name: Galarian Zigzagoon

attacks.name: Pin Missile
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

cards.name: Galarian Linoone

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

cards.name: Galarian Obstagoon

abilities.name: Wicked Ruler
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may have your opponent discard cards from their hand until they have 4 cards in their hand.

attacks.name: Knuckle Impact
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

cards.flavorText: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

cards.name: Absol
cards.flavorText: The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.

cards.name: Purrloin

attacks.name: Fake Out
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

cards.name: Liepard

abilities.name: Limber
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this troublesome Pokémon.

cards.name: Scrafty

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Bad Brawl
attacks.text: If you played Piers from your hand during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: As halfhearted as this Pokémon's kicks may seem, they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr's concrete pillars.

cards.name: Trubbish

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

cards.name: Inkay

attacks.name: Attack from Behind
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Confused, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

cards.name: Malamar

attacks.name: Eerie Wave
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Random Peck
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar's control.

cards.name: Nickit

attacks.name: Filch
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

cards.name: Duraludon V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Hard Coat
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Gatling Slug
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each Metal Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Altaria

abilities.name: Miraculous Charm
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon V and Pokémon-GX.

cards.flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Bede
rules: Attach a basic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Full Heal
rules: Remove all Special Conditions from your Active Pokémon.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Great Ball
rules: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Hop
rules: Draw 3 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Hyper Potion
rules: Heal 120 damage from 1 of your Pokémon that has at least 2 Energy attached. If you healed any damage in this way, discard 2 Energy from it.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Kabu
rules: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. If your Active Pokémon is your only Pokémon in play, draw 8 cards instead.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Marnie
rules: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 4 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Milo
rules: Discard up to 2 cards from your hand, and draw 2 cards for each card you discarded in this way.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Piers
rules: Search your deck for an Energy card and a Darkness Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Weedle

attacks.name: Bug Hunch
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Grass Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

cards.name: Kakuna

attacks.name: Shed Skin
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

cards.name: Beedrill

abilities.name: Elusive Master
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is the last card in your hand, you may play it onto your Bench. If you do, draw 3 cards.

cards.flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

cards.name: Exeggutor

attacks.name: Head Crack
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack.

cards.flavorText: Each of its three heads has its own thoughts. When they want to go in different directions, Exeggutor becomes unable to move.

cards.name: Yanma

attacks.name: U-turn
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

cards.name: Yanmega

attacks.name: U-turn
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

cards.name: Pineco

attacks.name: Iron Defense
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

cards.flavorText: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.

cards.name: Celebi

attacks.name: Energy Press
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Amazing Bloom
attacks.text: For each of your Benched Pokémon, search your deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has the ability to move through time. Records describing it as a forest deity can be found from many different eras.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.flavorText: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.

cards.name: Nuzleaf
cards.flavorText: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

cards.name: Shiftry

abilities.name: Shifty Substitution
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, each Supporter card in your opponent's hand has the effect "Draw 3 cards." (This happens instead of the card's usual effect.)

attacks.name: Fan Tornado
attacks.text: You may have your opponent switch their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

cards.name: Nincada

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

cards.name: Ninjask

abilities.name: Cast-off Shell
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may search your deck for Shedinja and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.

cards.name: Shaymin

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flower Bearing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent shuffles their Active Pokémon and all attached cards and puts them on the bottom of their deck.

cards.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Genesect

attacks.name: Linear Attack
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Techno Blast
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

cards.name: Skiddo

attacks.name: Synthesis
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

cards.name: Gogoat

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

cards.name: Dhelmise

attacks.name: Special Anchor
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

cards.name: Orbeetle V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mysterious Wave
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Orbeetle VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Eerie Beam
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: G-Max Wave
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Zarude V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Bind Down
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Jungle Rising
attacks.text: You may attach up to 2 basic Energy cards from your hand to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, heal all damage from that Pokémon.

cards.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

cards.name: Charmeleon

attacks.name: Raging Flames
attacks.text: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck.

cards.flavorText: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

cards.name: Charizard

abilities.name: Battle Sense
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Discard the other cards.

attacks.name: Royal Blaze
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Leon card in your discard pile.

cards.flavorText: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

cards.name: Flareon

abilities.name: Incandescent Awakening
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has a Memory Capsule attached, Grass Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities.

cards.flavorText: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon's body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Slugma

attacks.name: Yawn
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

cards.name: Magcargo

attacks.name: Bright Flame
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

cards.name: Talonflame V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Fast Flight
attacks.text: If you go first, you can use this attack during your first turn. Discard your hand and draw 6 cards.

attacks.name: Bright Wing
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.name: Vaporeon

abilities.name: Torrential Awakening
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has a Memory Capsule attached, Fire Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities.

cards.flavorText: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

cards.name: Wailmer

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

cards.name: Wailord

abilities.name: Water Veil
abilities.text: Whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, remove all Special Conditions from it.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

cards.name: Dewott

attacks.name: Aqua Wash
attacks.text: You may put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.

cards.flavorText: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.

cards.name: Samurott

abilities.name: Swaddling Leaves
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Aqua Wash
attacks.text: You may put 2 Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.

cards.flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

cards.name: Galarian Darmanitan V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Freezing Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Frozen Slice
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

cards.name: Galarian Darmanitan VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Max Whiteout
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Chewtle

attacks.name: Jaw Lock
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

cards.flavorText: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

cards.name: Drednaw

attacks.name: Vise Wave
attacks.text: If you played Nessa from your hand during this turn, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

cards.name: Cramorant

attacks.name: Continuous Gulp Missile
attacks.text: Discard any number of Arrokuda from your Bench. This attack does 60 damage for each Arrokuda you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: Cramorant's gluttony led it to try to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat.

cards.name: Arrokuda

attacks.name: Flock
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Arrokuda and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

cards.name: Barraskewda

attacks.name: Targeted Skewer
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon for each damage counter on that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

cards.name: Pikachu V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Lightning Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.name: Pikachu VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: G-Max Volt Tackle
attacks.text: You may discard all Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 150 more damage.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Electrode

abilities.name: Buzzap Generator
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may search your deck for up to 2 Lightning Energy cards and attach them to your Lightning Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. If you searched your deck in this way, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.

cards.flavorText: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

cards.name: Jolteon

abilities.name: Thunderous Awakening
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has a Memory Capsule attached, Water Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities.

cards.flavorText: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

cards.name: Zapdos

attacks.name: Thunder Snipe
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 160 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon V or Pokémon-GX. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Ampharos V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Dazzle Blast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Damaging Spark
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Raikou

attacks.name: Amazing Shot
attacks.text: This attack also does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

cards.name: Electrike

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

cards.name: Grookey
cards.flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

cards.name: Scorbunny

attacks.name: Super Singe
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

cards.name: Sobble

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

cards.name: Meowth V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Pay Day
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.name: Meowth VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: G-Max Gold Rush
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Rillaboom

abilities.name: Voltage Beat
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Grass Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

cards.name: Frosmoth

abilities.name: Ice Dance
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Water Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Water Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

cards.name: Galarian Perrserker

abilities.name: Steely Spirit
abilities.text: Your Metal Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

cards.name: Cinccino

abilities.name: Make Do
abilities.text: You must discard a card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Energy Assist
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its body secrets oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

cards.name: Gossifleur

attacks.name: Sing
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

cards.name: Wooloo

attacks.name: Defense Curl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

cards.name: Morpeko

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

cards.name: Galarian Ponyta

attacks.name: Heal Pulse
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its small horn hides a healing power. With a few rubs from this Pokémon's horn, any slight wound you have will be healed.

cards.name: Rillaboom V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Forest Feast
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Grass Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Wood Hammer
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

cards.name: Cinderace V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Field Runner
abilities.text: If a Stadium is in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

cards.name: Inteleon V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Snipe Shot
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Aqua Report
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

cards.name: Toxtricity V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Energize
attacks.text: Attach a Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Venom Slap
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.name: Zacian V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Intrepid Sword
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and attach any number of Metal Energy cards you find there to this Pokémon. Put the other cards into your hand. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

attacks.name: Brave Blade
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

cards.name: Zamazenta V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Dauntless Shield
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon VMAX.

attacks.name: Assault Tackle
attacks.text: Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Iron Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Polteageist V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Teapot of Surprises
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if it is Knocked Out), choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and puts it on the bottom of their deck.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.name: Flapple

abilities.name: Apple Drop
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you placed any damage counters in this way, shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

attacks.name: Acid Spray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

cards.name: Luxray
